comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__abo_api

AbiOption API

valid

The ``AbiOption`` API shall mirror ``std::optional`` / ``Option<T>`` without introducing extra fields or indirections.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__abo_flg

AbiOption is_some flag

valid

``AbiOption.is_some`` shall be ``false`` when empty and ``true`` when containing a value.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__abs_fld

AbiString field semantics

valid

``AbiString.len`` shall report the current byte count; ``AbiString.capacity`` shall equal the compile-time size ``N``.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__abs_noa

AbiString API

valid

The ``AbiString`` API shall mirror the applicable parts of ``std::basic_string`` / ``String``, but shall not allocate or reallocate memory.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__abs_ovf

AbiString overflow check

valid

Any attempt to exceed ``AbiString.capacity`` shall result in a checked runtime error.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__abv_fld

AbiVec field semantics

valid

``AbiVec.len`` shall report the current element count; ``AbiVec.capacity`` shall equal the compile-time size ``N``.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__abv_noa

AbiVec API

valid

The ``AbiVec`` API shall mirror ``std::vector`` / ``Vec<T>``, but shall not allocate or reallocate memory.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__abv_ovf

AbiVec overflow check

valid

Any attempt to exceed ``AbiVec.capacity`` shall result in a checked runtime error.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__ari_api

AbiResult API

valid

The ``AbiResult`` API shall mirror ``std::expected`` / ``Result<T, E>`` without hidden storage or pointers.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__ari_flg

AbiResult is_err flag

valid

``AbiResult.is_err`` shall be ``false`` if ``value.ok`` is valid, and ``true`` if ``value.err`` is valid.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__arr_fix

Fixed-size arrays

valid

For ABI compatibility, fixed-size arrays shall be declared as ``[T; N]`` in Rust and with a wrapper around ``T[N]`` to perform bounds-checking in C++, where T itself conforms to the ABI compatibility rules.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__bool_sz

Restrict boolean size

valid

For ABI compatibility, the implementation shall restrict boolean types to one byte (``bool`` in Rust) and to the bit patterns ``0x00`` and ``0x01``.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__char

Characters

valid

For ABI compatibility, the Unicode character type shall use fixed-width definitions (``char`` in Rust; wrapper around ``std::uint32_t`` in C++), and shall restrict values to the ranges ``0x0`` to ``0xD7FF`` and ``0xE000`` to ``0x10FFFF``.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__compabi

Compiler-agnostic ABI

valid

For ABI compatibility, all native types shall be ABI-compatible across compilers (e.g. GCC and Clang) using the same endianness.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__enum_udr

Explicit enum representation

valid

For ABI compatibility, enums shall have an explicit, fixed underlying representation (e.g. ``#[repr(u8)]`` in Rust; ``enum class E : std::uint8_t`` in C++).

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__flt_sz

Limit floating-point sizes

valid

For ABI compatibility, floating-point types shall be limited to 32-bit (``f32`` in Rust / ``float`` in C++) and 64-bit (``f64`` in Rust / ``double`` in C++); all floating-point representations shall be compliant with IEEE 754.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__int_fix

Fixed-width integers

valid

For ABI compatibility, all integer types shall use fixed-width definitions (``uN``/``iN`` in Rust; ``std::uintN_t``/``std::intN_t`` in C++), for N ∈ {8, 16, 32, 64}.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__nop_mt

Disallow pointers and metadata

valid

For ABI compatibility, types shall not contain absolute pointers, references, slices, function pointers, vtables, or any language-specific metadata.

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__prv_abo

Provide AbiOption<T>

valid

An ABI-compatible ``AbiOption<T>`` type shall be provided in both C++ and Rust with the specified layout. .. code-block:: rust #[repr(C)] pub struct AbiOption<T> { is_some: bool, value: T, } .. code-block:: cpp template<typename T> struct AbiOption { private: AbiBool is_some; T value; };

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__prv_abs

Provide AbiString<N>

valid

An ABI-compatible ``AbiString<N>`` type shall be provided in both C++ and Rust with the specified layout. .. code-block:: rust #[repr(C)] pub struct AbiString<const N: usize> { len: u32, bytes: [u8; N], } .. code-block:: cpp template<std::uint32_t N> struct AbiString { private: std::uint32_t len; std::uint8_t bytes[N]; };

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__prv_abv

Provide AbiVec<T,N>

valid

An ABI-compatible ``AbiVec<T, N>`` type shall be provided in both C++ and Rust with the specified layout. .. code-block:: rust #[repr(C)] pub struct AbiVec<T, const N: usize> { len: u32, elements: [T; N], } .. code-block:: cpp template<typename T, std::uint32_t N> struct AbiVec { private: std::uint32_t len; T elements[N]; };

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__prv_ari

Provide AbiResult<T,E>

valid

An ABI-compatible ``AbiResult<T, E>`` type shall be provided in both C++ and Rust with the specified layout. .. code-block:: rust #[repr(C)] pub struct AbiResult<T, E> { is_err: bool, value: AbiResultUnion<T, E>, } #[repr(C)] union AbiResultUnion<T, E> { ok: ManuallyDrop<T>, err: ManuallyDrop<E>, } .. code-block:: cpp template<typename T, typename E> struct AbiResult { private: AbiBool is_err; union { T ok; E err; } value; };

comp_req__abi_compatible_data_types__st_tpl

Struct and tuple ABI layout

valid

For ABI compatibility, tuples and structs shall preserve field order, use ``#[repr(C)]`` in Rust, and be ``standard_layout`` in C++ (no inheritance or virtuals).

comp_req__bitmanipulation__bit_operations

Support for Bit Operations

valid

The bit manipulation component shall provide an API for setting, clearing, toggling, and checking individual bits for any integral type up to 64 bits, returning boolean success status.

comp_req__bitmanipulation__bitmask_operators

Support for Bitmask Operators for Enum Classes

valid

The bit manipulation library shall provide type-safe bitmask operations for scoped enumeration types.

comp_req__bitmanipulation__bounds_safety

Bounds and Safety Checks

valid

The bit manipulation functions shall validate input parameters against bounds and, on out-of-bounds access, shall leave the target value unmodified and return false.

comp_req__bitmanipulation__byte_extraction

Support for Byte Extraction

valid

The bit manipulation component shall provide an API to extract the byte at a given position from any integral type up to 64 bits.

comp_req__bitmanipulation__byte_operations

Support for Byte and Half-Byte Types

valid

The bit manipulation component shall provide byte and half-byte types, with a byte composable from and decomposable into two half-bytes.

comp_req__bitmanipulation__header_only

Header-only API

valid

The bit manipulation API shall be header-only and not require external dependencies.

comp_req__communication__logging

Error logging

valid

In case, that there is no related Event Type Info source provided in shared memory for a given Event enlisted in the deployment for the proxy, an ERROR message shall be logged.

comp_req__concurrency__condition_variable

Interruptible Condition Variable

valid

The concurrency module shall provide an abortable mechanism for threads to wait for conditions.

comp_req__concurrency__delayed_task

Delayed Task Execution

valid

The concurrency module shall provide implementation for executing callable objects after a specified delay with support for early cancellation.

comp_req__concurrency__error_handling

Future Error Handling

valid

The concurrency module shall use error codes instead of throwing exceptions.

comp_req__concurrency__executor_interface

Executor Interface

valid

The concurrency module shall provide interface defining a common API for task submission operations, graceful shutdown, and maximum concurrency level reporting.

comp_req__concurrency__interruptible_wait

Interruptible Wait Utilities

valid

The concurrency module shall provide utilities offering APIs for sleep operations allowing early cancellation.

comp_req__concurrency__long_running_threads

Long-Running Threads Container

valid

The concurrency module shall provide a container for managing long-running threads, allowing addition and removal of threads.

comp_req__concurrency__memory_reservation

Memory Reservation

valid

The concurrency module shall allow reserving memory upfront for tasks to ensure predictable resource allocation.

comp_req__concurrency__memory_usage_control

Memory Usage Control

valid

The concurrency module shall limit memory usage to prevent uncontrolled resource consumption.

comp_req__concurrency__notification

Notification Mechanism

valid

The concurrency module shall allow one thread to notify another thread once, with a timeout option.

comp_req__concurrency__operation_timeout

Operation Timeout Protection

valid

The concurrency module shall avoid indefinitely blocking, unabortable operations.

comp_req__concurrency__periodic_task

Periodic Task Execution

valid

The concurrency module shall provide implementation for executing callable objects at regular intervals with configurable first execution time and period duration.

comp_req__concurrency__simple_task

Simple Task Implementation

valid

The concurrency module shall provide implementation for executing callable objects without returning results, supporting fire-and-forget asynchronous operations.

comp_req__concurrency__synchronized_queue

Synchronized Queue

valid

The concurrency module shall provide a thread-safe container facilitating FIFO transmission of data in a N:1 communication pattern.

comp_req__concurrency__task_cancellation

Task Cancellation

valid

The concurrency module shall allow cancelling tasks when needed.

comp_req__concurrency__task_interface

Asynchronous Task Execution

valid

The concurrency module shall allow running tasks asynchronously.

comp_req__concurrency__task_result

Task Result Management

valid

The concurrency module shall provide implementation to access the result of an asynchronously running task or to request aborting the task when the result is no longer needed.

comp_req__concurrency__thread_count_reporting

Thread Count Reporting

valid

The concurrency module shall report the maximum number of concurrent threads available for task execution.

comp_req__concurrency__thread_pool

Thread Pool Implementation

valid

The concurrency module shall provide implementation that manages submitted tasks in FIFO order.

comp_req__containers__deterministic_behavior

Deterministic Behavior

valid

The Containers library shall provide deterministic behavior with no dynamic memory allocation.

comp_req__containers__dynamic_array

Dynamic Array

valid

The Containers library shall provide a fixed-size array container with construction-time size specification.

comp_req__containers__intrusive_list

Intrusive List

valid

The Containers library shall provide an intrusive doubly-linked list based on the C++ standardization proposal P0406R1.

comp_req__containers__non_relocatable_vector

Non-Relocatable Vector

valid

The Containers library shall provide a non-relocatable vector container that maintains stable element addresses.

comp_req__containers__type_safety

Type Safety

valid

The Containers library shall enforce compile-time type safety for all container operations.

comp_req__containers_rust__det_behavior

Deterministic Behavior

valid

The Rust containers library shall provide deterministic behavior.

comp_req__containers_rust__fixed_btree

Fixed-Capacity B-Tree

valid

The Rust Containers library shall provide a heap-allocated B-tree container with construction-time capacity specification.

comp_req__containers_rust__fixed_hashmap

Fixed-Capacity Hashmap

valid

The Rust Containers library shall provide a heap-allocated hashmap container with construction-time capacity specification.

comp_req__containers_rust__fixed_hashset

Fixed-Capacity Hashset

valid

The Rust Containers library shall provide a heap-allocated hashset container with construction-time capacity specification.

comp_req__containers_rust__fixed_no_realloc

No Reallocation

valid

Fixed-capacity containers shall never allocate or re-allocate memory after their initial construction.

comp_req__containers_rust__fixed_queue

Fixed-Capacity Queue

valid

The Rust Containers library shall provide a heap-allocated double-ended queue container with construction-time capacity specification.

comp_req__containers_rust__fixed_string

Fixed-Capacity String

valid

The Rust Containers library shall provide a heap-allocated, UTF-8 encoded string data type with construction-time capacity specification.

comp_req__containers_rust__fixed_vector

Fixed-Capacity Vector

valid

The Rust Containers library shall provide a heap-allocated vector container with construction-time capacity specification.

comp_req__containers_rust__inline_btree

Inline-Storage B-Tree

valid

The Rust Containers library shall provide a B-tree container with a capacity determined at compile-time, which stores the elements within the data structure itself. This container shall have a stable, precisely defined memory layout, capable of serving as the basis for an ABI-compatible B-tree.

comp_req__containers_rust__inline_hashmap

Inline-Storage Hashmap

valid

The Rust Containers library shall provide a hashmap container with a capacity determined at compile-time, which stores the elements within the data structure itself. This container shall have a stable, precisely defined memory layout, capable of serving as the basis for an ABI-compatible hashmap.

comp_req__containers_rust__inline_hashset

Inline-Storage Hashset

valid

The Rust Containers library shall provide a hashset container with a capacity determined at compile-time, which stores the elements within the data structure itself. This container shall have a stable, precisely defined memory layout, capable of serving as the basis for an ABI-compatible hashset.

comp_req__containers_rust__inline_no_heap

No Heap Allocation

valid

Inline-storage containers shall never allocate heap memory.

comp_req__containers_rust__inline_queue

Inline-Storage Queue

valid

The Rust Containers library shall provide a queue container with a capacity determined at compile-time, which stores the elements within the data structure itself. This container shall have a stable, precisely defined memory layout, capable of serving as the basis for an ABI-compatible queue.

comp_req__containers_rust__inline_string

Inline-Storage String

valid

The Rust Containers library shall provide a UTF-8 encoded string data type with a capacity determined at compile-time, which stores the codepoints within the data structure itself. This container shall have a stable, precisely defined memory layout, capable of serving as the basis for an ABI-compatible string.

comp_req__containers_rust__inline_vector

Inline-Storage Vector

valid

The Rust Containers library shall provide a vector container with a capacity determined at compile-time, which stores the elements within the data structure itself. This container shall have a stable, precisely defined memory layout, capable of serving as the basis for an ABI-compatible vector.

comp_req__containers_rust__type_safety

Type Safety

valid

The Rust Containers library shall enforce compile-time type safety for all container operations.

comp_req__data_router__dlt_bw_quota_config

DLT Bandwidth Quota Configuration

valid

The component shall have the DLT bandwidth quota configuration in the file located at ``./etc/log-channels.json`` relative to the application specific location ``/opt/``.

comp_req__data_router__dlt_message_filtering

DLT Message Filtering

valid

DLT server shall support filtering of messages within each channel. The filter shall be parametrized with application ID, context ID, log level threshold. Initial filter set shall be part of channel configuration file, located in the following path: ``<data_router binary location>/../etc/log-channels.json``.

comp_req__data_router__dlt_multiple_channels

DLT Multiple Channel Support

valid

DLT server shall support multiple log channels as specified in AUTOSAR Diagnostic, Log and Trace Protocol Specification. The following parameters shall be configurable statically via a deployment-specific configuration file (``<data_router binary location>/./etc/log-channels.json``): Number and names of channels, Network configuration for channel output, Log level threshold per channel, Log channel assignments per application/context.

comp_req__data_router__dlt_quota_bw_reduction

DLT Quota Bandwidth Reduction

valid

It shall be possible to configure the action to drop DLT messages when a quota is exceeded. Note: The configuration shall be provided as an attribute as part of the DLT quota configuration file (:need:`comp_req__data_router__dlt_bw_quota_config`).

comp_req__data_router__dlt_server

Datarouter DLT Server

valid

Datarouter shall implement DLT server component. Datarouter provides the functionality to send messages using DLT protocol over UDP multicast transport.

comp_req__data_router__dlt_verbose_messages

DLT Verbose Messages

valid

DLT server shall provide support for verbose DLT messages. Messages sent from mw::log library shall be sent via DLT using verbose mode.

comp_req__feo__act_alloc_error

Activity resource allocation error

valid

During initialization (i.e. in the startup function of an activity), activities shall check for resource allocation and report an error to the executor in case of failure.

comp_req__feo__act_map_cfg

Activity Mapping Configuration

valid

The mapping of activities to threads is done in the component configuration and cannot be changed at runtime.

comp_req__feo__act_shutdown_error

Activity shutdown error

valid

If an activity fails in the shutdown function, the primary process shall shutdown all remaining activities in arbitrary sequence and terminate itself.

comp_req__feo__act_startup_error

Activity startup error

valid

If an error occurs during the execution of a startup function, the primary process shall abort calling startup functions and terminate itself. For all of the activities whose startup functions have already been called successfully, the corresponding shutdown functions shall be executed in arbitrary sequence.

comp_req__feo__act_stepping_error

Activity stepping error

valid

If an activity fails in the step function, the primary process shall call shutdown for all activities in arbitrary sequence and terminate itself.

comp_req__feo__act_timeout

Activity timeout

valid

If a timeout occurs during startup, stepping or shutdown of an activity, the primary process shall shutdown all successfully started activities in arbitrary sequence and terminate itself.

comp_req__feo__activitiy_step

Stepping of Activities

valid

Each Activity shall be stepped once within each execution of the Task Chain they belong to. Stepping is done by a call to an activity's `step` function. The `step` function shall be invoked in the thread to which the activity is mapped.

comp_req__feo__activitiy_thread

Mapping of Activities to threads

valid

Each activity shall be mapped to one thread. The mapping cannot be changed at runtime. Each activity's `init`, `step` and `shutdown` functions shall be executed in the assigned thread.

comp_req__feo__activity

Activity

valid

Each activitiy is mapped to exactly one thread within the primary or one of the secondary processes. Each activity provides the following functions: * `init`: Initialization of the activity. * `step`: Execution of the activity. * `shutdown`: Shutdown of the activity.

comp_req__feo__activity_init

Initialization of Activities

valid

Initialization of Activities shall be done during application initialization. Each Activity shall be initialized by a call to its `init` function. The `init` function shall be invoked in the thread to which the activity is mapped.

comp_req__feo__activity_shutdown

Shutdown of activities

valid

Shutdown of activities shall be done during application shutdown. Each activity shall be shut down by a call to its `shutdown` function. The `shutdown` function shall be invoked in the thread to which the activity is mapped.

comp_req__feo__agent

Agent

valid

In order to execute activities in secondary processes, the Scheduler shall use agents running in the secondary processes. There shall be exactly one agent for each secondary process. The Agent in a secondary process shall receive commands from the Scheduler, invoke actions on Activities within its process and report back to the Scheduler. Each Activity that is part of the task chain in a secondary process shall be associated with an Agent, which takes over the task to wait for a trigger from the Scheduler. When the Agent gets a step request from the Scheduler, it calls the Step function of the Activity.

comp_req__feo__alive_supervision

Alive supervision

valid

The component shall provide the functionality to enable the reporting of alive supervision checkpoint to an external health management system (e.g. watchdog)

comp_req__feo__application

Application Processes

valid

An application consists of one or more activities executed in one or multiple operating system processes. In particular it consists of the primary process which handles the lifecycle, configuration and execution management. It may optionally consist of one or more secondary processes. The purpose of secondary processes is to run code in separate address spaces (Freedom From Interference) for safety reasons. Each process (primary and secondary) belongs to exactly one application. Each process contains one ore more operating system threads.

comp_req__feo__application_lifecycle

Application Lifecycle Phases

valid

The Application Lifecycle shall consists of 3 phases: Init, Run and Shutdown.

comp_req__feo__comp_cfg

Component Configuration

valid

The component shall provide a configuration mechanism that supports configuring - the mapping of activities to threads - the execution order of activities - when the task chain is activated (e.g. a cycle time for cyclic execution)

comp_req__feo__comp_cfg_file

Component Configuration from File

valid

It shall be possible to define the component configuration in a pre-defined configuration file.

comp_req__feo__deadline_supervision

Support of deadline supervision checkpoints

valid

The component shall provide the functionality to enable the reporting of deadline supervision checkpoints to an external health management system (e.g. watchdog)

comp_req__feo__logical_supervision

Support of logical supervision

valid

The component shall provide the functionality to enable the reporting of logical supervision checkpoints to an external health management system (e.g. watchdog)

comp_req__feo__response_term_request

Response to termination request

valid

If the primary process receives a termination signal, it shall call the shutdown function of all remaining activities in arbitrary sequence and terminate itself. If a secondary process receives a termination signal, it shall terminate itself.

comp_req__feo__scheduler

Scheduler aka Executor

valid

The component shall implement a scheduler (aka executor) that manages the execution of activities in correct order.

comp_req__feo__secondary_conn_timeout

Secondary connection timeout

valid

If not all secondary processes connect to the primary in time, the primary shall terminate itself. The startup functions shall not be triggered.

comp_req__feo__service_activity

Service Activity

valid

The component shall enable the implementation and execution of Service Activities, which are a means to interact with the outside world, e.g. via network communication, direct sensor input or direct actuator output. A Service Activity shall be enabled to use APIs external to the framework (e.g. networking APIs, reading from external sensor devices, writing HW I/O, etc.)

comp_req__feo__startup_timeout

Startup timeout

valid

If not all activities reach their initialized state within a certain period of time (startup timeout), the primary process shall shutdown all successfully started activities in arbitrary sequence and terminate itself.

comp_req__feo__task_chain

Task Chain

valid

All activities within an application are arranged within a `Task Chain`. There is exactly one task chain per application. The task chain configuration defines the execution order of the activities. In particular it defines when the task chain is activated (typically in a cyclic manner) and in which order the activities will run. Every task chain may have one or multiple input service activities which will run in the beginning. The purpose of an input service activity is to collect external input signals and provide them to the other activities during task chain execution. Every task may have one or more output service activities which will run in the end. The purpose of an output service activity is to collect signals produced by activities within the task chain and send them to external entities.

comp_req__feo__trustable_computation

Trustable computation

valid

The component shall provide mechanisms to check after the computation of an Activity if the result is trustable. This can be done e.g. via evaluation of floating point exceptions, checking of hardware registers or status information of the software platform.

comp_req__filesystem__api_abstraction

Standard Filesystem Abstraction

valid

The Filesystem library shall provide filesystem API based on the C++ standardization.

comp_req__filesystem__directory_iterators

Directory Iterators

valid

The Filesystem library shall provide directory iterator types for traversing directory contents.

comp_req__filesystem__file_io

File I/O Operations

valid

The Filesystem library shall provide functionality for reading from and writing to files, including buffered I/O operations.

comp_req__filesystem__file_utils

File Utility Functions

valid

The Filesystem library shall provide additional file utility functions, such as temporary file handling and file comparison.

comp_req__filesystem__full_testability

Fully testable public API

valid

The public API of the library shall support dependency injection with test doubles. Note: This enables full testability of the user code.

comp_req__filesystem__mock_fake

Mock and Fake Implementations

valid

The Filesystem library shall provide mock and fake implementations for unit testing and validation.

comp_req__filesystem__path_utilities

Path Manipulation Utilities

valid

The Filesystem library shall provide type-safe utilities for path construction and manipulation.

comp_req__flatbuffers__access

FlatBuffers Access

valid

The FlatBuffers-Library shall provide functionality to read FlatBuffers binary data. .. note:: FlatBuffers uses a zero-copy approach where data is accessed directly from the binary buffer.

comp_req__flatbuffers__asil

FlatBuffers library ASIL level

valid

The FlatBuffers library shall be ASIL-B compliant for C++ and Rust language support.

comp_req__flatbuffers__buffer_identification

Common Buffer Identification

valid

The FlatBuffers-Library shall provide a common opt-in buffer identification mechanism consisting of a major version, a minor version, and a 4-character identifier.

comp_req__flatbuffers__serialization

FlatBuffers Serialization

valid

The FlatBuffers-Library shall provide functionality to serialize data into the FlatBuffers binary format. .. note:: Although this is only required for future use cases and not for the module configuration, it is already included, as excluding it would require extensive patching of ``flatc`` functionality.

comp_req__flatbuffers__verification

FlatBuffers Verification

valid

The FlatBuffers-Library shall provide a verification mechanism to validate the structural well-formedness of a FlatBuffers buffer. .. note:: Verification only validates the buffer structure (e.g. offsets, vtables, field boundaries), not the correctness or integrity of the payload data.

comp_req__flatbuffers__version_check

Common Version Check

valid

The FlatBuffers-Library shall provide a common opt-in version check mechanism that validates the major version, minor version, and 4-character identifier of a FlatBuffers buffer.

comp_req__hash__calculation_interface

Hash Computation from Byte Data

valid

The hash library shall compute a hash value over a contiguous byte sequence supplied by the caller, accumulating state across one or more data inputs and producing the final digest upon finalization.

comp_req__hash__crc32_algorithm

CRC-32 Checksum Algorithm

valid

The hash library shall support IEEE CRC-32 as a checksum algorithm.

comp_req__hash__factory_interface

Algorithm Selection via Factory

valid

The hash library shall allow the hash algorithm to be selected and a calculator instance to be created independently of the code that performs the computation, so that the calling code is not coupled to any specific algorithm implementation.

comp_req__hash__safe_computation

Exception-Free Error Propagation

valid

The hash library shall propagate errors from hash calculator instantiation via return-value types, enabling use in safety-critical contexts where exception handling is not available.

comp_req__hash__sha_algorithms

Cryptographic Hash Algorithms

valid

The hash library shall support SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 as cryptographic hash algorithms.

comp_req__hash__value_retrieval_bytes

Hash Value Retrieval as Raw Bytes

valid

The hash library shall expose the computed hash value as a raw byte sequence.

comp_req__hash__value_retrieval_hex

Hash Value Retrieval as Hexadecimal String

valid

The hash library shall expose the computed hash value as a hexadecimal string representation.

comp_req__health_monitor__dummy

Dummy Component

valid

.. note:: This is a dummy component requirement. See https://github.com/eclipse-score/lifecycle/issues/366 for more information. .. note:: This is linked to an arbitrary feature requirement to avoid metamodel errors. Fix link when writing down component requirements.

comp_req__json__asil

JSON library ASIL level

valid

The JSON library shall be ASIL-B compliant.

comp_req__json__deserialization

JSON Deserialization

valid

The JSON-Library shall provide a service to deserialize JSON data according to RFC8259, i.e. parse and check for well-formedness.

comp_req__json__full_testability

Fully testable public API

valid

The public API of the library shall support dependency injection with test doubles. Note: This enables full testability of the user code.

comp_req__json__lang_idioms

Support for programming language idioms

valid

The public API shall support the idioms of the programming language it is written in.

comp_req__json__lang_infra

Use programming language infrastructure

valid

The public API shall use core infrastructure of its programming language and accompanying standard libraries, whenever possible and meaningful. Note: This includes error handling.

comp_req__json__serialization

JSON Serialization

valid

The JSON-Library shall provide a service to serialize user format into JSON data according to RFC8259.

comp_req__json__type_compatibility

Enforce strict type compatibility

valid

The public API shall enforce strict type compatibility. When a user requests a value, the API shall validate that the requested return type is compatible with the type and value of the stored JSON data. Note: This includes checking if the stored value exceeds the range of the expected type.

comp_req__json__user_format

Return data in user format

valid

The JSON-Library shall return parsed data in a compatible user format. Note: The user format shall be a regular type and not defined within the library.

comp_req__kvs__async_api

Async API

valid

The component shall provide an asynchronous API in addition to the standard API.

comp_req__kvs__callback_support

Callback Support

valid

The component shall provide an API for registering callbacks that are triggered by data change events.

comp_req__kvs__concurrency

Concurrency

valid

The component shall implement thread-safe mechanisms to enable concurrent access to data without data races.

comp_req__kvs__constraints

Constraint Configuration

valid

The component shall allow configuration of KVS constraints at compile-time using source code constants or at runtime using a configuration file.

comp_req__kvs__default_val_chksum

Default Value Checksum

valid

The component shall secure the configuration file for default values with an associated checksum file when default values are stored in a file.

comp_req__kvs__default_value_cfg

Default Value Config

valid

The component shall allow configuration of default values in code or in a separate configuration file.

comp_req__kvs__default_value_query

Default Value Query

valid

The component shall provide an API to retrieve default values.

comp_req__kvs__default_value_types

Default Value Datatypes

valid

The component shall accept default values of only permitted value data types.

comp_req__kvs__eng_mode

Engineering Mode

valid

The component shall provide an engineering mode that can be enabled during build time to display debugging and internal information.

comp_req__kvs__field_mode

Field Mode

valid

The component shall provide a field mode that can be enabled during build time to restrict access as much as possible.

comp_req__kvs__key_encoding

Key Encoding

valid

The component shall encode each key as valid UTF-8.

comp_req__kvs__key_length

Key Length

valid

The component shall limit the maximum length of a key to 32 bytes.

comp_req__kvs__key_naming

Key Naming

valid

The component shall accept keys that consist solely of alphanumeric characters, underscores, or dashes.

comp_req__kvs__key_uniqueness

Key Uniqueness

valid

The component shall guarantee that each key is unique.

comp_req__kvs__multi_instance

Multi-Instance

valid

The component shall manage all runtime variables within an instance to enable creation and use of multiple KVS instances concurrently within a single software architecture element.

comp_req__kvs__permission_control

Permission Control

valid

The component shall rely on the underlying filesystem for access and permission management and shall not implement its own access or permission controls.

comp_req__kvs__permission_err_hndl

Permission Error Handling

valid

The component shall report any access or permission errors encountered at the filesystem level to the application.

comp_req__kvs__pers_data_csum

Persistent Data Storage Checksum Write

valid

The component shall generate a checksum for each data file and shall store it alongside the data.

comp_req__kvs__pers_data_csum_vrfy

Persistent Data Storage Checksum Verify

valid

The component shall verify the checksum when loading data.

comp_req__kvs__pers_data_schema

Persistent Data Schema

valid

The component shall use a JSON file storage format that enables the application to implement versioning, including upgrade and downgrade paths, as needed.

comp_req__kvs__pers_data_store_bnd

Persistent Data Storage Backend

valid

The component shall use the file API to persist data.

comp_req__kvs__pers_data_store_fmt

Persistent Data Storage Format

valid

The component shall use the JSON data format to persist data.

comp_req__kvs__pers_data_version

Persistent Data Versioning

valid

The component shall not provide built-in versioning.

comp_req__kvs__persist_data_com

Persistent Data Storage Components

valid

The component shall use the file API and the JSON data format to persist data.

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_creation

Snapshot Creation

valid

The component shall create a snapshot each time data is stored.

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_delete

Snapshot Deletion

valid

The component shall allow deletion of individual snapshots.

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_id

Snapshot IDs

valid

The component shall assign the ID 1 to the newest snapshot and shall increment the IDs of older snapshots accordingly.

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_max_num

Snapshot Maximum Number

valid

The component shall maintain a configurable maximum number of snapshots.

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_restore

Snapshot Restore

valid

The component shall allow restoration of a snapshot by its ID.

comp_req__kvs__snapshot_rotate

Snapshot Rotation

valid

The component shall rotate and delete the oldest snapshot when the maximum number is reached.

comp_req__kvs__value_data_types

Value Data Types

valid

The component shall accept only values of the following data types: Number, String, Null, Array[Value], or Dictionary{Key:Value}.

comp_req__kvs__value_default

Value Default

valid

The component shall support unset values and shall provide a default value when a value is unset.

comp_req__kvs__value_length

Value Length

valid

The component shall limit the maximum length of a value to 1024 bytes.

comp_req__kvs__value_reset

Value Reset

valid

The component shall allow resetting a value to its default if a default is defined.

comp_req__kvs__value_serialize

Value Serialization

valid

The component shall serialize and deserialize all values to and from JSON.

comp_req__launch_man__aslr_support

ASLR support

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching process with :term:`ASLR` (Address Space Layout Randomization).

comp_req__launch_man__capability_support

Process capability support

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching :term:`Processes <Process>` with configured OS-specific capabilities and privileges.

comp_req__launch_man__central_default_defines

Global process properties

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall be able to centrally define defaults for specific properties for the set of executables.

comp_req__launch_man__check_dependency_exec

Condition check based on at least one dependency

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a method to check if at least one dependency has been executed.

comp_req__launch_man__cond_process_start

Conditionally launch of processes

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support to conditionally start a process or process group based on the return value of a single or multiple :term:`Processes <Process>` executed before.

comp_req__launch_man__condition_check_method

Condition check based on status

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a method for condition check based on process state.

comp_req__launch_man__config_actions_cond

Configuration of action based on condition evaluation

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a way to configure actions based on condition evaluation i.e. to be able to configure SUCCESS and FAILURE case.

comp_req__launch_man__configurable_timeout

Stop timeout

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for configurable timeout :term:`Interval` to wait for the process to be stopped.

comp_req__launch_man__configurable_wait_time

Monitoring and recovery: recovery wait time

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for configurable wait time that shall elapse before repeating :term:`Recovery Action`.

comp_req__launch_man__consistent_dependencies

Invalid dependency

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall reject an inconsistent definition of set of executables dependencies.

comp_req__launch_man__cwd_support

CWD support

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a given :term:`Working Directory`.

comp_req__launch_man__dag_logging_controlif

Logging DAG

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide the possibility to log the :term:`DAG` in a human readable format, triggered via :term:`Control Interface`.

comp_req__launch_man__debug_support

Launching process in debug mode

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching process with a given set of debug arguments in debug mode.

comp_req__launch_man__define_swc_dependencies

Condition check for each SWC its dependencies

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a way to define for each :term:`SWC` (Software Components), its dependencies.

comp_req__launch_man__dependency_check

Condition check based on all dependency

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a method to check if all dependencies have been executed.

comp_req__launch_man__dependency_visu

Configuration dependency view

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall have the means to log the current dependencies in a format that can be visualized when requested.

comp_req__launch_man__detach_parent_process

Process detach from parent support

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process to detach from parent.

comp_req__launch_man__drop_supervsion

Dropping process responsibility

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support to dropping all surveillance and failure reaction activities of :term:`Processes <Process>`.

comp_req__launch_man__env_variable_cond_check

Condition check based on ENV

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a method for condition check for environment variable.

comp_req__launch_man__ext_monitor_notify

Process state notification

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for external monitors to get notified on process life status.

comp_req__launch_man__failure_detect

Process launch monitoring

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall be able to detect and react to failure of the process launch.

comp_req__launch_man__fast_shutdown_support

Fast shutdown

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall support fast shutdown by terminating itself without considering the started :term:`Processes <Process>`.

comp_req__launch_man__fd_inheritance

File descriptor inheritance support

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with given :term:`File Descriptor` inheritance restrictions.

comp_req__launch_man__launch_manager_shutdown

Normal shutdown

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall support normal shutdown by terminating all process in the dependency order.

comp_req__launch_man__launch_priority_support

Process priority support

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a given priority.

comp_req__launch_man__launcher_exit_shutdown

Launch Manager shutdown

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall exit after performing shutdown operation by stopping all the :term:`Processes <Process>` it owns in the dependency order when requested.

comp_req__launch_man__launcher_status_storage

Launched Process status

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a way to store the status of the launched process.

comp_req__launch_man__lazy_check

Lazy check of configured commands

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall check availability of executables in the filesystem only when the executable shall required to be executed.

comp_req__launch_man__lm_ext_watchdog_cfg

Launch manager external monitoring configuration

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall support configuring the :term:`Interval` of the internal health check executions.

comp_req__launch_man__lm_ext_watchdog_notify

Launch manager external watchdog notification

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall trigger a notification to an external :term:`Watchdog` for each successful self monitoring test execution.

comp_req__launch_man__lm_ext_wdg_failed_test

Launch manager external watchdog notification - failed test

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall not trigger an external :term:`Watchdog` notification if an internal health check failed.

comp_req__launch_man__log_timestamp

Logging timestamp

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` logs shall contain timestamp information.

comp_req__launch_man__modular_config_support

Configuration file support

valid

The launch manager shall provide modular configuration file support to configure process attributes.

comp_req__launch_man__monitoring_processes

Monitoring and recovery: adopted process monitoring

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for monitoring adopted :term:`Processes <Process>`.

comp_req__launch_man__multi_start_support

Multiple instance of executable

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall permit an executable to be launched more than once.

comp_req__launch_man__offline_config_valid

Configuration Verification tool

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall have a means to validate the configuration offline.

comp_req__launch_man__path_condition_check

Condition check based on path

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide a method for condition check for a path.

comp_req__launch_man__polling_interval

Conditional launch polling interval

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for per condition configurable :term:`Polling Interval` for launch conditions to be checked.

comp_req__launch_man__process_failure_react

Recovery

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall be able to react to a process failure by optionally performing one of relaunching the process, stopping the process, stopping the process and starting another process, or triggering :term:`QNX` :term:`Operating System` Device Safe State (:term:`DSS`).

comp_req__launch_man__process_input_output

Forward process information

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support to pass the output of one or multiple :term:`Processes <Process>` as input arguments to another process.

comp_req__launch_man__process_launch_args

Handling process args

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a given set of arguments.

comp_req__launch_man__process_logging_support

Logging state transitions

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for logging process launches, :term:`Processes <Process>` exit/recovery, internal tasks, and interaction with external monitor.

comp_req__launch_man__process_rlimit_support

Resource limit support

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a given set of system resource limits (rlimit).

comp_req__launch_man__process_state_comm

Process state

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall have a means for the launched :term:`Processes <Process>` to communicate a state, which represents the launched processes' internal state, to the launcher.

comp_req__launch_man__retries_configurable

Configurable amount of retries

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall support a configurable amount of retries in case error occurs during startup of a component (e.g. file not available) occurs.

comp_req__launch_man__runmask_support

CPU runmask support

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a given runmask.

comp_req__launch_man__runtime_config_compat

Runtime configuration compliance

valid

The launch manager shall provide modular configuration files support for configurations coming from `OCI runtime configuration<https://github.com/opencontainers/runtime-spec/blob/v1.2.0/config.md>`.

comp_req__launch_man__scheduling_policy

Scheduling support

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with certain scheduling policy.

comp_req__launch_man__secpol_non_root

Non-root support

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support to be started with security policy as non-root.

comp_req__launch_man__shutdown_signal

Shutdown signal handling

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall implement a shutdown by sending a SIGTERM to the process. In case the process does not terminate itself, a SIGKILL shall be sent.

comp_req__launch_man__slog2_logging

Logging slog2 and file support

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall support OS specific logging facilities to analyze the early boot sequence.

comp_req__launch_man__std_handle_redir

Standard handle redirection

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for stdin, stdout, stderr redirection.

comp_req__launch_man__stop_order_spec

Coordination stop dependency

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall permit the stop order of non-dependent processes to be specified.

comp_req__launch_man__stop_process_dependents

Dangling dependency

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall be able to stop a process when all it's dependents are stopped if specified in the set of executables.

comp_req__launch_man__supplementary_groups

Supplementary group support

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a given set of supplementary groups.

comp_req__launch_man__support_held_state

Launching process in state waiting for a debugger connection

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process in a state waiting for a debugger connection.

comp_req__launch_man__support_secpol_type

Security policy support

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a given security policy.

comp_req__launch_man__terminal_support

Launching terminal

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a terminal or a session leader.

comp_req__launch_man__time_to_wait_config

Configurable delay between SIGTERM and SIGKILL

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall offer a configuration of the time to wait before SIGKILL is sent. In case "0" is stated, the SIGKILL shall be sent immediately.

comp_req__launch_man__total_wait_time_support

Condition timeout

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for per condition configurable total wait time for launch conditions to be satisfied.

comp_req__launch_man__uid_gid_support

Process user, group IDs support

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall provide support for launching a process with a given :term:`UID`/:term:`GID` (user name/Group Identifier).

comp_req__launch_man__validate_conditions

Pre-start validation

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall be able to validate the pre-start conditions of the executable using the conditions.

comp_req__launch_man__validation_conditions

post-start validation

valid

The :term:`Launch Manager` shall be able to validate the start of the executable using the conditions.

comp_req__log__autosar_log_trace_spec

AUTOSAR Log and Trace Specification

valid

mw::log shall implement "Specification of Log and Trace for Adaptive Platform". Release of specification used shall be in agreement with the rest of Adaptive AUTOSAR stack.

comp_req__log__avoid_locks

Avoid Locks

valid

mw::log shall be free of time-unbound locks and shall implement strategies to limit wait time. Time limit shall be defined based on requirements from functions on individual ECU. Mutual exclusion mechanisms shall include priority inversion protection.

comp_req__log__avoid_signal_processing

Avoid Signal Processing

valid

The component shall not register any signal handler.

comp_req__log__cfg_buffer_size

Logging Configuration Internal Buffer Size

valid

``mw::log`` shall allow configuration of the size of the internal buffer.

comp_req__log__cfg_custom_types

Custom Log Types

valid

``mw::log`` shall allow extensions for custom log types.

comp_req__log__cfg_defaults

Logging Configuration File Defaults

valid

``mw::log`` shall fall back to a default value for a configuration item that is not available from the configuration files. These are hard-coded in the library.

comp_req__log__cfg_file

Logging Configuration File

valid

``mw::log`` shall load configurations from an application-specific configuration file.

comp_req__log__cfg_file_loc

Logging Configuration File Location

valid

The application specific file shall be the first valid configuration file from the following locations. 1. location pointed to by the environmental variable ``MW_LOG_CONFIG_FILE`` 2. ``<cwd>/etc/logging.json`` 3. ``<cwd>/logging.json`` 4. ``<binary path>/../etc/logging.json``

comp_req__log__cfg_invalid

Logging Configuration Invalid Settings Handling

valid

``mw::log`` shall discard any invalid configuration fields. Invalid meaning that the value is not in the expected range or format.

comp_req__log__cfg_log_app_id

Logging Configuration Log Application Identifier

valid

``mw::log`` shall support configuration of an application log identifier, which shall be a DLT-style ASCII uppercase 4 character string.

comp_req__log__cfg_log_ecu_id

Logging Configuration Log ECU Identifier

valid

``mw::log`` shall support configuration of an ECU log identifier, which shall be a DLT-style ASCII uppercase 4 character string.

comp_req__log__cfg_precedence

Logging Configuration Precedence

valid

For each configuration field, ``mw::log`` shall resolve values using the following precedence order: 1. Application configuration file 2. Global configuration file 3. Defaults

comp_req__log__cfg_sink_device

Logging Configuration Log Storage Device

valid

``mw::log`` shall support configuration of a file path specifying where log are written.

comp_req__log__cfg_syntax_err

Logging Configuration Syntax Errors Handling

valid

``mw::log`` shall discard any configuration files with syntax errors and continue using other sources of configuration.

comp_req__log__compat_languages

Compatibility Supported Programming Languages

valid

``mw::log`` shall provide a logging API for C++ and Rust.

comp_req__log__compat_os

Compatibility Supported Operating Systems

valid

``mw::log`` shall support QNX and Linux operating systems, encapsulated via OSAL.

comp_req__log__console_backend

Console Backend Stdout Sink

valid

``mw::log`` shall support output log messages to stdout when running unit tests.

comp_req__log__cross_locking

Cross-Locking Prevention

valid

Cross-application and cross-thread dependencies shall be avoided. A thread logging in a loop shall not block other thread's execution.

comp_req__log__dlt_verbose_mode

DLT Verbose Mode

valid

mw::log shall implement DLT verbose mode. Generation of messages shall be done in DLT-conform format, allowing messages to be sent by Datarouter without additional reprocessing.

comp_req__log__file_descriptor_flags

File Descriptor Flags

valid

The component shall set the ``FD_CLOEXEC`` (or ``O_CLOEXEC``) flag on all the file descriptors it owns. Note: This requirement can be satisfied in unit-test, by checking ``int flags = fcntl(fd, F_GETFD); assert((flags != -1) && (flags & FD_CLOEXEC));`` for every file descriptor owned by the component.

comp_req__log__forward_to_system_logger

Forward to System Logger

valid

The system logger backend shall forward the logs to the native system logger mechanism. Note: Under QNX, slogger2 shall be used.

comp_req__log__global_config

Logging Global Configuration File

valid

``mw::log`` shall load configurations from a global configuration file. The global configuration shall be loaded from ``/etc/ecu_logging_config.json``

comp_req__log__inactive_logstream

Inactive LogStream Behavior

valid

mw::log library shall not perform any useful activity if log level of LogStream object is insufficient for given context. LogStream object shall not generate serialized messages if the severity of the message does not allow it to be sent.

comp_req__log__index_size_checking

Index and Size Checking

valid

Indices in data structures and sizes of data accessed or copied shall be checked for plausibility to avoid high runtime utilization through long iterations or data corruption.

comp_req__log__local_allocation_strategy

Local Allocation Strategy

valid

mw::log shall use local allocators to avoid using global heap. Global heap allocation (if any) shall be limited to initialization phase of application lifecycle.

comp_req__log__log_loss_detect

Message Loss Detection

valid

``mw::log`` shall detect and report any message loss.

comp_req__log__memory_bound_checking

Memory Bound Checking

valid

Memory boundaries shall be explicitly checked when writing to shared memory.

comp_req__log__no_endless_loops

No Endless Loops

valid

mw::log shall not contain unbound loops or loops with unchecked exit conditions.

comp_req__log__send_to_datarouter

Send Messages to Datarouter

valid

mw::log shall use logging library to send verbose messages to datarouter. Applications shall use mw::log interface to log verbose mode messages. Internally mw::log shall be using logging library.

comp_req__log__shm_file_permissions

Shared Memory File Permissions

valid

Logging shared-memory files shall have read-only posix file permission for group and others. The shared-memory file created by mw::log shall be read-only for group and others. Note: mw::log creates a shared memory file for each app.

comp_req__log__system_backend_activation

System Backend Activation

valid

The system logger backend shall be enabled if and only if the log mode contains "kSystem".

comp_req__log__system_logger

System Logger Backend

valid

``mw::log`` shall support logging of slog backed for QNX deployments.

comp_req__log__timestamp_local

Local Timestamp

valid

``mw::log`` shall attach a local timestamp to each log entry.

comp_req__memory__address_independence

Process Address Space Independence

valid

The Memory library shall ensure shared memory data structures remain valid regardless of process virtual address space mappings.

comp_req__memory__atomic_ops

Atomic Operations in Shared Memory

valid

The Memory library shall provide atomic operations on shared memory data for lock-free inter-process communication.

comp_req__memory__bounds_check

Memory Region Bounds Checking

valid

The Memory library shall track and validate memory region boundaries to prevent out-of-bounds access in shared memory.

comp_req__memory__deterministic_alloc

Deterministic Memory Allocation

valid

The shared memory allocation shall provide deterministic behavior with predictable execution time suitable for real-time automotive systems.

comp_req__memory__endianness

Endianness Conversion

valid

The Memory library shall provide byte order conversion between host and network byte order (big/little endian).

comp_req__memory__inter_process_sync

Inter-Process Synchronization

valid

The Memory library shall provide file-based locking mechanisms for inter-process synchronization and mutual exclusion.

comp_req__memory__offset_ptr

Polymorphic OffsetPtr Allocator

valid

The Memory library shall provide polymorphic memory resource allocators using offset pointers instead of raw pointers to enable allocation in shared memory regions accessible across multiple processes. The standard library's std::pmr::polymorphic_allocator is not applicable as it uses raw pointers that are invalid when shared memory is mapped at different virtual addresses in different processes.

comp_req__memory__resource_registry

Memory Resource Registry

valid

The Memory library shall provide a global registry for memory resource lookup and management.

comp_req__memory__sealed_shm

Sealed Shared Memory

valid

The Memory library shall provide immutable shared memory segments that become read-only after initialization.

comp_req__memory__shared_container

Shared Memory Container

valid

The Memory library shall provide type aliases for STL containers (vector, map, string) that use offset pointers for shared memory storage.

comp_req__memory__shared_memory

Shared Memory Management

valid

The Memory library shall provide capabilities for creating, opening and managing shared memory.

comp_req__memory__string_utils

String Utilities

valid

The Memory library shall provide zero-allocation string utilities including splitting, comparison, and compile-time literals.

comp_req__memory__typed_memory

Typed Memory

valid

The Memory library shall provide an interface to allocate shared memory from typed memory regions.

comp_req__orchestrator__deploy

Error logging

valid

The orchestrator shall provide an design interface.

comp_req__orchestrator__logging

Error logging

valid

In case, that there is an fault in the orchestration an ERROR message shall be logged.

comp_req__result__deterministic_behavior

Deterministic Behavior

valid

The Result library shall provide deterministic behavior with no dynamic memory allocation.

comp_req__result__domain_error_information

Domain-Specific Error Information

valid

The Result library shall support user-defined error domains and error codes.

comp_req__result__error_handling

Result-Based Error Handling

valid

The Result library shall provide an error handling mechanism that enables functions to return either successful values ("Get Value") or error information ("Get Error") without using C++ exceptions.

comp_req__result__exception_free_operation

Exception-Free Operation

valid

The Result library shall operate without throwing C++ exceptions.

comp_req__result__set_result

Set Result

valid

The Result library shall provide a "Set Result" operation that accepts either a successful value of type T or an Error object.

comp_req__result__std_integration

Standard Library Integration

valid

The Result library shall provide conversion utilities to transform Result objects into std::optional<T> types. The conversion shall require explicit handling of error cases before discarding error information, ensuring that errors cannot be silently ignored.

comp_req__result__type_safety

Type-Safe Error Handling

valid

The Result library shall enforce compile-time type safety for error handling operations.

comp_req__safecpp__aborts_upon_exception

C++ Exception Abort

valid

The safecpp library shall provide a mechanism to abort the program upon C++ exception allocation, allowing users to prevent any exception object from being created and hence to guarantee that no single exception will be possible to be thrown within an executable. .. Note:: This satisfies :need:`aou_req__platform__no_exceptions`

comp_req__safecpp__coverage_termination

Code Coverage Termination

valid

The safecpp library shall provide a mechanism which automatically registers a termination handler which ensures that code coverage data is also persisted upon any process exit (e.g. during gtest's Death Tests).

comp_req__safecpp__nullstring

Null-Terminated String

valid

The safecpp library shall provide a view type which guarantees that an underlying character sequence is guaranteed to be null-terminated. Such views type's underlying character sequence shall not be possible to get modified via such view type's methods.

comp_req__safecpp__safe_atomic

Safe Atomic operations

valid

The safecpp library shall provide a lock-free atomic addition operation for integral types with overflow detection.

comp_req__safecpp__safe_math

Safe Arithmetic Operations

valid

The safecpp library shall provide arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, negation, absolute value, type casting, and comparison operations) that detect overflow, underflow, divide-by-zero, and precision loss for both integer and floating-point types, ensuring errors are handled safely and undefined behavior is prevented.

comp_req__safecpp__scoped_guards

Scoped Guards

valid

The safecpp library shall provide scope-bound callable wrappers that prevent resource leaks.

comp_req__static_reflect_serial__compile_eff

Compile-Time Efficiency

valid

The library shall provide compile-time safety and efficiency of serialization operations with minimal runtime overhead.

comp_req__static_reflect_serial__container

Automatic Container Iteration

valid

The library shall automatically traverse containers using appropriate iteration.

comp_req__static_reflect_serial__header_only

Header-Only Implementation

valid

The library shall be implemented as a header-only library to enable compile-time optimizations and avoid runtime dependencies.

comp_req__static_reflect_serial__nested

Nested Type Support

valid

The library shall support serialization and visitation of nested data structures.

comp_req__static_reflect_serial__reflect

Static Reflection Support

valid

The library shall provide compile-time reflection-based serialization and deserialization for C++ Data Structures.

comp_req__static_reflect_serial__visitor

Generic Visitor Pattern

valid

The library shall provide a visitor pattern for traversal of C++ data structures.

comp_req__utils__base64_decoding

Base64 Decoding

valid

The Utils component shall provide functions for decoding Base64 data back to its original form.

comp_req__utils__base64_encoding

Base64 Encoding

valid

The Utils component shall provide functions for encoding data to Base64 format.

comp_req__utils__threadsafe_singleton

Thread-Safe Singleton Instance Creation

valid

The Utils component shall provide a thread-safe singleton whose instance is created exactly once when accessed concurrently by multiple threads.

comp_req__vajson__asil

VaJson library ASIL level

valid

The VaJson library shall be ASIL-B compliant.

comp_req__vajson__hex_integers

JSON Deserialization RFC extension hexadecimal integers

valid

VaJson shall accept hexadecimal integers. This behavior extends RFC 8259.

comp_req__vajson__trailing_commas

JSON Deserialization RFC extension trailing commas

valid

VaJson shall ignore trailing commas. This behavior extends RFC 8259.

comp_req__vajson__unicode

Unicode Support

valid

VaJson shall encode and decode UTF-8 encoded strings.

comp_req__vajson__validation

JSON Validation

valid

VaJson checks the well-formedness of JSON data. Errors shall include the reason and location in the JSON document for malformed JSON.

comp_saf_fmea__bitmanipulation__constraints

Bitmanipulation Constraints

valid

Constraints are checked, see mitigation requirement.

comp_saf_fmea__bitmanipulation__late_return

Bitmanipulation Late Return

valid

There is already an aou on platform level which states that a user has to use program flow monitoring

comp_saf_fmea__bitmanipulation__no_return

Bitmanipulation No Return

valid

There is already an aou on platform level which states that a user has to use the return values, so the error mode of no return should be covered, but there is no explicit mention that a "success" return is needed.

comp_saf_fmea__bitmanipulation__wrong_input

Bitmanipulation Wrong Input

valid

Wrongly defined Enum values are not checked by Bitmanipulation component, the output of the action may be unexpected. So the user has to make sure this is done in a right way, covered by the linked AoU.

comp_saf_fmea__result__error_code

Result Error Code Cross-Domain Misinterpretation

valid

If the user relies on the error code not only for diagnostic purposes but for selecting an error reaction path, misinterpreting the code under a wrong domain could lead to an incorrect safety-relevant decision. An Assumption of Use shall ensure the user verifies the error domain before interpreting the error code.

comp_saf_fmea__result__error_message_life

Result Error Message Lifetime Violation

valid

The existing Assumption of Use for resource lifetime addresses the validity of error domain objects and referenced resources. However, it does not explicitly cover the user-provided error message, which is equally subject to lifetime constraints. The AoU should be extended to explicitly include the error message data, or a separate AoU should be established for it.

comp_saf_fmea__result__stop_user

Result Stop User

valid

The Result library invokes user-provided operations synchronously during transformation of values or errors. Ensuring these operations terminate is outside the scope of the library and is the responsibility of the user via program flow monitoring, as covered by the referenced platform-level Assumption of Use.

comp_saf_fmea__result__unchecked

Result Unchecked Value or Error Access

valid

If the user accesses the value or the error without first verifying the state of the result, the program will deterministically terminate. The provided Assumptions of Use require the user to check and handle both states before access.

dec_rec__logging__explicit_init

Explicit initialization of logging

proposed

Provide a library for explicit initialization of logging. **Context:** Currently there are multiple approaches to logging initialization. Rust frontend configuration is provided as code and requires explicit initialization before any logging starts. C++ configuration is lazily loaded on first use and based on a JSON file with path provided using environment variable. This approach discrepancy makes it difficult to manage logging in multi-language environment. Issue can be solved by providing an explicit initialization library. Such explicit logging initialization shall: - Initialize logging for Rust and C++ environments. - Handle configuration of all sub-components of the logging environment. - Provide interfaces to Rust and C++. Examples of use: - Initialize logging in Rust application: - Rust logging frontend - C++-based backend - Rust/C++ log bridge - Initialize logging in C++ application utilizing Rust-based libraries: - C++ logging - Rust logging frontend utilized by libraries - C++-based backend - Rust/C++ log bridge **Consequences** Such change will require design changes to middleware logging. In Rust it is a common practice to explicitly initialize logging before any logging starts. This is true to both `score_log` logging frontend and ubiquitous `log` crate that is a defacto standard for logging in Rust. Middleware logging library is currently initialized lazily on first use, using JSON config file. It is not possible to perform the initialization operation explicitly. **Justification for the Decision** Explicit logging initialization will simplify logging initialization in multi-language environments.
