feat_req__ai_platform__embedded_efficiency

Efficient Embedded Runtime

valid

The platform shall optimize runtime performance and memory usage to meet the constraints of automotive edge hardware.

feat_req__ai_platform__model_verification

Verified Model Execution

valid

The platform shall ensure model artifacts are verified via cryptographic signatures before execution, and model loading is restricted to trusted paths.

feat_req__ai_platform__qnx_linux_support

Cross-OS Portability

valid

The platform shall support portable AI components that run on both QNX (ASIL-B) and Linux environments.

feat_req__ai_platform__safety_backends

ASIL-B ML Inference

valid

The platform shall support deployment of safety-certified inference backends and abstraction layers for ASIL-B use cases.

feat_req__ai_platform__static_backend

Static Backend Selection

valid

The platform shall select inference backends statically at build time to ensure deterministic runtime behavior.

feat_req__ai_platform__workloads_execution

ML Execution

valid

The platform shall support the execution of traditional ML models on embedded automotive hardware.

feat_req__baselibs__abi_containers

ABI-Compatible Containers

valid

The base libraries shall provide a library of containers that can serve as the basis for ABI-compatible container data structures.

feat_req__baselibs__bitmanipulation

Bit Manipulation Library

valid

The base libraries shall provide bit manipulation utilities for low-level operations on integral types.

feat_req__baselibs__concurrency_library

Concurrency Library

valid

The base libraries shall provide a library for parallel execution of C++ callables with thread pool management.

feat_req__baselibs__containers_library

Container Library

valid

The base libraries shall provide a container library offering additional container types not present in the ISO C++17 standard library.

feat_req__baselibs__filesystem_library

Filesystem Library

valid

The base libraries shall provide a filesystem library with file and directory manipulation functionality.

feat_req__baselibs__flatbuffers_library

FlatBuffers Library

valid

The base libraries shall provide a FlatBuffers library with serialization, read access, and structural verification of FlatBuffers data. .. note:: FlatBuffers library provides both ASIL-B and QM compliant functionality depending on the programming language, the separation is done on component level.

feat_req__baselibs__hash_library

Hash Library

valid

The base libraries shall provide a hash library supporting cryptographic hash calculation (e.g. SHA-256, SHA-512) and checksum algorithms (e.g. CRC-32) over byte data and streams via a pluggable interface.

feat_req__baselibs__json_library

JSON Library

valid

The base libraries shall provide a JSON library with parsing functionality.

feat_req__baselibs__memory_library

Memory Library

valid

The base libraries shall provide a memory management library that includes utilities for shared memory operations, polymorphic memory resources, position-independent pointers, endianness conversion, and inter-process synchronization mechanisms.

feat_req__baselibs__multi_language_apis

Multi-Language APIs

valid

The base libraries shall provide APIs for C++, Rust, or both, depending on the requirements of consuming platform components.

feat_req__baselibs__panic_free_development

Panic-Free Development Support

valid

The base libraries shall provide error handling mechanisms that enable development without relying on Rust panics. Where an idiomatic interface requires panics, an additional non-panicking option shall be provided as well.

feat_req__baselibs__result_library

Result Library

valid

The base libraries shall provide error handling mechanisms that enable development without relying on C++ exceptions.

feat_req__baselibs__static_reflection_library

Static Reflection Library

valid

The base libraries shall provide a static reflection library enabling compile-time reflection-based serialization and deserialization of C++ data structures.

feat_req__baselibs__utils_library

Utils Library

valid

The base libraries shall provide a utils library with general-purpose utility functionality, including Base64 encoding and decoding, scoped operations, string views, safe integer arithmetic, safe atomic operations, and defined program termination handling.

feat_req__code_generation__definitionlanguage

The system uses a human-readable definition language.

valid

The system shall be modeled in YAML-syntax files. This means the system should use YAML due to the availability of parsers in Rust and C++. The system should prefer YAML over JSON due to its simpler syntax.

feat_req__code_generation__deinitialization

Software Compute Units correctly deallocate any dynamically allocated memory in the onShutdown function.

valid

Software Compute Unit instances shall have onInit and onShutdown called only once during their lifecycle.

feat_req__code_generation__error_handling1

Software Compute Units do not throw exceptions or "panic".

valid

Software Compute Units shall handle any exceptions in dependency libraries completely inside the standard interface functions. Software Compute Units shall signal an error by returning an Error that contains an ErrorCode other than Success. Software Compute Units shall terminate execution if unhandled exceptions occur.

feat_req__code_generation__error_handling2

Software Compute Units do not attempt to trigger program termination.

valid

Software Compute Units shall return an Error with a suitable Errorcode and follow the defined error propagation mechanism to handle errors. Software Compute Units shall not manage their own lifecycle.

feat_req__code_generation__error_handling3

Software Compute Units do not call their own standard interface methods.

valid

Software Compute Units shall not interfere with their external lifecycle management by calling their own interface methods (onInit, onUpdate, onReset, onShutdown). Software Compute Units may call onReset() from onShutdown() if required for avoiding code duplication.

feat_req__code_generation__error_handling4

Software Compute Units implement transient error recovery mechanisms in onReset.

valid

Software Compute Units shall signal transient errors as a failure of onUpdate. The responsible Software Compute Unit shall trigger onReset to recover from transient errors based on logic modeled for the Archetype.

feat_req__code_generation__error_handling5

Software Compute Units signal reset and recovery failures via the Error return value of onReset.

valid

Software Compute Units shall be considered to have failed permanently if they return a failure on onReset.

feat_req__code_generation__initialization

Software Compute Units signal initialization failures by returning an Error indicating failure.

valid

Software Compute Unit Instances shall be considered to have failed permanently if they fail to initialize.

feat_req__code_generation__nomultithreading

Software Compute Units do not spawn a variable number of threads.

valid

Software Compute Units shall have a predetermined number of threads if they spawn any threads at all. Software Compute Units shall not dynamically spawn and join or detach worker threads.

feat_req__com__acl_for_consumer

Access Control List for consumer

valid

The communication framework shall support an Access Control List for the communication partner consuming a service instance. An entry in the ACL corresponds to an allowed producer.

feat_req__com__acl_for_producer

Access Control List for producer

valid

The communication framework shall support an Access Control List for the communication partner offering a service instance (producer). An entry in the ACL corresponds to an allowed consumer.

feat_req__com__acl_per_service_instance

Access Control List per service instance

valid

The communication framework shall support an Access Control List per service instance.

feat_req__com__acl_placement

Access Control List Placement

valid

The communication framework shall support an Access Control Lists in the deployment configuration.

feat_req__com__asil

Communication ASIL level

valid

The communication framework shall support safe communication up to ASIL-B.

feat_req__com__async_support

Asynchronous support

valid

The system shall provide asynchronous bi-directional support via multiple queues.

feat_req__com__bi_directional_comm

Bi-directional communication

valid

The system shall support bi-directional communication via writable data elements by the client.

feat_req__com__binding_agnostic_api

Binding-agnostic public API

valid

The public API of the communication framework shall be binding-agnostic. .. note:: Binding-agnostic in this context means, that the public API is independent of the binding underneath. E.g., if the binding is exchanged, the public API remains syntactically and semantically unchanged.

feat_req__com__config_notifications

Configurable notifications

valid

Notifications shall be configurable by consumers of data (using flags or watermarks in shared memory from client to producer).

feat_req__com__configurable_queues

Configurable queues

valid

Queues shall be configurable by the client (VM), including the number of elements and buffer allocation.

feat_req__com__consistent_data

Consistent data-sets

valid

The system shall support consistent data-sets, allowing the consumer to obtain a consistent version of related data items.

feat_req__com__data_corruption

Data Corruption

valid

Consumers with lower criticality shall not be able to corrupt data consumed by partners with higher criticality.

feat_req__com__data_driven_arch

Support for Data-driven Architecture

valid

The communication framework shall provide API to support a data-driven architecture.

feat_req__com__data_loss

Data Loss

valid

Consumers with lower criticality shall not be able to drop data before it is consumed by partners with higher criticality.

feat_req__com__data_notifications

Data update notifications

valid

Notifications for data updates shall be available (virtual IRQs in a VM).

feat_req__com__data_reordering

Data Reordering

valid

Consumers with lower criticality shall not be able to modify the order of data consumed by partners with higher criticality.

feat_req__com__data_repetition

Data Repetition

valid

Consumers with lower criticality shall not be able to duplicate data consumed by other communication partners with higher criticality.

feat_req__com__depl_config_runtime

Deployment configuration at runtime

valid

Deployment configuration shall be read from an integrity-checked configuration file at runtime.

feat_req__com__event_type

Event Type

valid

An event-type is part of a communication interface and has: - a name - a data type The producer can assign a value to it. Consumers can subscribe to value-changed events of the element or poll unseen, cached events.

feat_req__com__interfaces

Communication Interfaces

valid

A communication interface consists of a combination of any number of the following elements: - Event-Types - Methods - Signals

feat_req__com__lang_idioms

Support for programming language idioms

valid

Each public API shall support the idioms of the programming language it is written in.

feat_req__com__lang_infra

Use programming language infrastructure

valid

Each public API shall use core infrastructure of its programming language and accompanying standard libraries, whenever possible and meaningful. .. note:: This includes error handling.

feat_req__com__lock_free_access

Lock-free access

valid

Consistent access to data must be lock-free.

feat_req__com__lock_free_queue

Lock-free queue access

valid

Queues shall support lock-free access to data elements.

feat_req__com__method

Method

valid

A method is part of a communication interface and has: - a name - a specified application routine with a given set of parameters and a return type When a communication partner issues a call to the method with the required parameters: #. it shall invoke the application routine with the provided parameters, and #. return its result to the communication partner A method call shall be possible both synchronously and asynchronously.

feat_req__com__multi_binding_depl

Multi-binding deployment configuration

valid

The association of a service instance and the appropriate binding shall be specified in the deployment configuration.

feat_req__com__multi_binding_support

Multi-binding support

valid

The communication framework shall support multiple bindings. .. note:: A binding performs the conversion of user communication to the respective communication protocol. It does this either directly or via a gateway approach.

feat_req__com__multi_lang

Support for multiple programming languages

valid

The communication framework shall provide a public API for each supported programming language of S-CORE.

feat_req__com__one_way_sharing

One-way data sharing into a VM

valid

The system shall support one-way data sharing into a Virtual Machine (VM) for vehicle state read-only for the VM (snapshot state).

feat_req__com__producer_consumer

Producer-Consumer Pattern

valid

Communication shall be cached based on the producer-consumer pattern.

feat_req__com__producer_timestamps

Producer time stamps

valid

Producer time stamps shall be available for related data-sets.

feat_req__com__readonly_vm

Read-only access for VM

valid

The consumer (VM) shall have read-only access to the shared data.

feat_req__com__request_driven_arch

Support for Request-driven Architecture

valid

The communication framework shall provide API to support a request-driven architecture.

feat_req__com__safe_communication

Safe communication over criticality levels

valid

The communication framework shall support safe communication involving communication partners on the same or multiple criticality levels.

feat_req__com__service_discovery

Service discovery

valid

The communication framework shall provide service discovery to find available services during runtime. Service discovery shall consider version compatibility. Service discovery shall be handled implicitly (where possible). .. note:: The service discovery may be restricted/impacted by availability of deployment information.

feat_req__com__service_instance

Service Instance

valid

Multiple service instances shall be able to offer the same interface. .. note:: A communication interface that is offered to consumers is called a service instance.

feat_req__com__service_instance_granularity

Service instance_granularity

valid

The communication framework shall support multiple service instances per software architecture element. .. note:: A software architecture element is for example an application, activity, proces, ...

feat_req__com__service_instance_names

Service Instance Names

valid

A service instance is offered under one or more unique names by which it can be discovered. Names follow a POSIX path style. .. note:: The resolution from a service instance name to the protocol-specific identifier is handled by the service discovery.

feat_req__com__service_location_transparency

Service location transparency

valid

The interface to access service instances is agnostic to the binding used to communicate with the service. .. note:: Deployment information may require manual changes based on where the service is located.

feat_req__com__shared_memory

Shared memory chunks

valid

The system shall support multiple chunks of shared memory to allow required access control.

feat_req__com__signal

Signal

valid

A signal is part of a communication interface and has: - a name A client can trigger the signal. The service instance offering the trigger can: - wait for the signal to be triggered - check if the signal was triggered .. note:: Signals can not transport data. They are meant to be fast synchronization mechanism with low setup cost. Thus, depending on the location of the communication partners primitives like Linux Signals or QNX Pulses or Hypervisor Signalling APIs may be chosen.

feat_req__com__stateless_communication

Stateless communication

valid

The communication framework shall support stateless communication. .. note:: - In case of events, the producer is not aware of its consumers. - In case of RPC, the skeleton is not aware of the proxy, this request originated from.

feat_req__com__streamed_data

Streamed data based on shared queues

valid

The system shall support streamed data based on shared queues (stream of events or data).

feat_req__com__testability_fake_binding

Fake binding

valid

The communication framework shall provide a fake binding.

feat_req__com__testability_mock_api

Fully mockable public API

valid

The public API shall be fully mockable.

feat_req__com__time_based_arch

Support for Time-based Architecture

valid

The communication framework shall provide API to support a time-based architecture.

feat_req__com__tracing

Support for Tracing

valid

The communication framework shall provide infrastructure to enable binding-agnostic, zero-copy, read-only tracing of communication.

feat_req__com__versioning

Versioning

valid

The communication framework shall support versioning of service instances: - Version information of a service instance is binding-specific. - Version information is provided in the deployment configuration. .. note:: Multiple service instances can have the same interface and version.

feat_req__com__zero_copy

Zero-Copy Approach

valid

The communication framework shall enable Zero-Copy communication without copying to-be-transferred data. .. note:: It has to be evaluated on binding level if a Zero-Copy approach is applicable for the respective binding.

feat_req__config_mgmt__central_housekeeping

Central housekeeping for Parameters

valid

Configuration Management shall provide a central housekeeping for Parameters.

feat_req__config_mgmt__parameter_modification

Parameter modification

valid

Parameter values shall be modifiable during runtime regarding modification procedure specific for a parameter kind.

feat_req__config_mgmt__parameter_set_access

Parameter Set access

valid

A Parameter Set shall be accessible via interface using a key-value principle, where user application passes a Parameter Set name to the interface and its value is returned as result.

feat_req__config_mgmt__parameter_set_relation

Parameter relation to a Set

valid

Every Parameter shall be contained in exactly one Parameter Set.

feat_req__config_mgmt__prm_initial_qualifier

Parameter initial qualifier

valid

There shall exist an overall qualifier for all Parameter Sets to indicate the state of integrity checks at the point of time of initial provision of parameters.

feat_req__config_mgmt__prm_name_unique

Parameter name uniqueness

valid

Parameters names shall be unique for an ECU project.

feat_req__config_mgmt__prm_set_cfg_content

Parameter Set configuration contents

valid

Parameter Set configuration shall contain a mapping of Parameters to Parameter Sets, Parameter names and default values.

feat_req__config_mgmt__prm_set_cfg_source

Parameter Set configuration source

valid

Parameter Set configuration shall be determined solely by a read-only input source, deployed on the target.

feat_req__config_mgmt__prm_set_name_unique

Parameter name uniqueness

valid

Parameters Set names shall be unique for an ECU project.

feat_req__config_mgmt__prm_set_qualifier

Parameter Set qualifier

valid

A Parameter Set shall contain a qualifier to indicate its integrity.

feat_req__config_mgmt__provider_interface

Config provider interface

valid

Configuration Management shall provide a generic interface, independent of any Parameter definitions, for applications to access Parameters in read-only mode.

feat_req__config_mgmt__term_parameter

Term definition of Parameter

valid

An individual vehicle configuration property used for vehicle specific adaptations is called ``Parameter``.

feat_req__config_mgmt__term_parameter_set

Term definition of Parameter Set

valid

Group of Parameters which belong to the same functionality and share an integrity protection is called ``Parameter Set``.

feat_req__daal__com

Communication

valid

The communication layer should use the IPC Framework

feat_req__daal__env

Execution Environments

valid

It should be possible to use the framework with all specified os like qnx and linux

feat_req__daal__health_error

Health & Error Management

valid

Error and Health Management should be availability

feat_req__daal__lifecycle

Lifecycle Interface

valid

Lifecycle of executables should use one generic API

feat_req__daal__log

Logging

valid

Core Logging API should be used

feat_req__daal__time_based_arch

Support for Time-based Architecture

valid

The daal framework shall provide Trigger to support a time-based architecture.

feat_req__daal__trigger

Trigger

valid

Singe Shot and Cyclic execution should be possible

feat_req__diagnostics__classic_adapter

Classic Diagnostic Adapter

valid

The system shall include a classic diagnostic adapter to translate SOVD requests into UDS commands.

feat_req__diagnostics__classic_adapter_odx

Classic Diagnostic Adapter ODX Configuration

valid

The classic diagnostic adapter shall support configuration via ODX files that describe the UDS command mappings and behavior per ECU.

feat_req__diagnostics__db

Diagnostic Database

valid

The system shall include a diagnostic database to store DTCs, occurrence counts, and associated metadata for fault events.

feat_req__diagnostics__db_persistence

Diagnostic Database Persistence

valid

The diagnostic database shall store all diagnostic data persistently.

feat_req__diagnostics__fault_catalog_agg

Fault Catalog Aggregation

valid

The Diagnostic Fault Manager shall be configureable via the aggregated fault catalog derived from all fault libraries in the system.

feat_req__diagnostics__fault_lib

Diagnostic Fault Library

valid

The system shall include a fault reporting library that provides an interface for applications and platform components to report diagnostic faults including metadata.

feat_req__diagnostics__fault_lib_catalog

Fault Library Catalog

valid

The fault library shall provide the ability to define faults via a component fault catalog for the scope of the respective parent component.

feat_req__diagnostics__fault_lib_debounce

Fault Library Debouncing

valid

The fault library shall support configurable error debouncing.

feat_req__diagnostics__fault_manager

Diagnostic Fault Manager

valid

The system shall include a central diagnostic fault manager that aggregates data from fault libraries, provides DTC status to the SOVD server, and interfaces with a persistent diagnostic database.

feat_req__diagnostics__internal_com

Diagnostic system internal communication

valid

All internal communication between diagnostic components that do not use UDS or SOVD protocols shall be implemented using the S-CORE::COM middleware.

feat_req__diagnostics__oem_plugin

OEM Diagnostic Plug In

valid

The diagnostic system shall provide a plug-in mechanism to include OEM-specific features.

feat_req__diagnostics__service_app

Diagnostic Service Application

valid

The diagnostic system shall include a base service application (AKA routine) that is triggered by the SOVD Server and used to derive custom service applications.

feat_req__diagnostics__sovd_auth_mgr

SOVD Server Authentication Integration

valid

The SOVD server shall enforce access control and validate client credentials.

feat_req__diagnostics__sovd_client

SOVD Client

valid

The system shall provide a SOVD client to allow external applications to communicate with the SOVD server.

feat_req__diagnostics__sovd_client_core

SOVD Client Deployment Core

valid

The SOVD client shall be designed as a reusable core component that can be deployed in off-board, on-board, or cloud environments.

feat_req__diagnostics__sovd_config

SOVD Configuration

valid

The system shall provide configuration management for SOVD components, including protocol parameters and security settings.

feat_req__diagnostics__sovd_config_mgr

SOVD Server Configuration Integration

valid

The SOVD server shall integrate with the S-CORE Configuration Manager to support runtime access and modification of configuration data.

feat_req__diagnostics__sovd_gateway

SOVD Gateway

valid

The system shall include a SOVD gateway to route diagnostic requests between different network domains and protocols.

feat_req__diagnostics__sovd_server

SOVD Server

valid

The diagnostic system shall include a central SOVD server that exposes diagnostic functionality via a standard REST interface.

feat_req__diagnostics__sovd_std

SOVD Standard

valid

The SOVD implementation shall conform to the SOVD standard as defined in ISO/DIS 17978 (or the latest available draft or final publication).

feat_req__diagnostics__uds2sovd_odx

UDS2SOVD Proxy ODX Configuration

valid

The UDS2SOVD proxy shall support configuration via standardized ODX files to define which SOVD services are exposed via the UDS interface.

feat_req__diagnostics__uds2sovd_proxy

UDS to SOVD Proxy

valid

The system shall include a proxy to translate UDS diagnostic requests to SOVD protocol requests.

feat_req__feo__act_alloc_error

Activity resource allocation error

valid

During initialization (i.e. in the startup function of an activity), activities shall check for resource allocation and report an error to the executor in case of failure.

feat_req__feo__act_shutdown_error

Activity shutdown error

valid

If an activity fails in the shutdown function, the primary process shall shutdown all remaining activities in arbitrary sequence and terminate itself.

feat_req__feo__act_startup_error

Activity startup error

valid

If an error occurs during the execution of a startup function, the primary process shall abort calling startup functions and terminate itself. For all of the activities whose startup functions have already been called successfully, the corresponding shutdown functions shall be executed in arbitrary sequence.

feat_req__feo__act_stepping_error

Activity stepping error

valid

If an activity fails in the step function, the primary process shall call shutdown for all activities in arbitrary sequence and terminate itself.

feat_req__feo__act_timeout

Activity timeout

valid

If a timeout occurs during startup, stepping or shutdown of an activity, the primary process shall shutdown all successfully started activities in arbitrary sequence and terminate itself.

feat_req__feo__activitiy_step

Stepping of activities

valid

Each activity is stepped once within each execution of the task chain they belong to. Stepping is done by a call to an activity's `step` function.

feat_req__feo__activity

Definition: Activity

valid

Activities are mapped to threads within primary or secondary processes. Each activity is mapped to exactly one thread and provides the following functions: * `init`: Initialization of the activity. * `step`: Execution of the activity. * `shutdown`: Shutdown of the activity. The mapping is done in a configuration file and cannot be changed at runtime.

feat_req__feo__activity_init

Initialization of activities

valid

Initialization of activities is done during application initialization. Each activity is initialized by a call to its `init` function. The `init` function will be invoked in the thread to which the activity is mapped. Note that `init`, `step` and `shutdown` functions will be run in the same thread.

feat_req__feo__activity_shutdown

Shutdown of activities

valid

Shutdown of activities is done during application shutdown. Each activity is shut down by a call to its `shutdown` function. The `shutdown` function will be invoked in the thread to which the activity is mapped.

feat_req__feo__agent

Definition: Agent

valid

In order to execute activities in secondary processes, the executor makes use of an `Agent` for each secondary process and possibly also the primary process. The agent receives commands from the executor, invokes actions on activities within its process and reports back to the executor. Each Activity that is part of the task chain is associated with an Agent, which takes over the task to wait for a trigger from its corresponding Executor. When the Agent gets a step request from the Executor, it calls the Step function of the Activity There is exactly one agent for each secondary process. The primary can but doesn't have to be associated with an agent.

feat_req__feo__alive_supervision

Alive supervision

valid

The framework shall provide the functionality to enable the reporting of alive supervision checkpoint to an external health management system (e.g. watchdog)

feat_req__feo__application

Definition: Application

valid

An application consists of one or more activities. An application consists of one or more operating system processes. In particular it consists of the primary process which handles the lifecycle, configuration and execution management. It may optionally consist of one or more secondary processes. The purpose of secondary processes is to run code in separate address spaces (Freedom From Interference) for safety reasons. Each process (primary and secondary) belongs to exactly one application. Each process contains one ore more operating system threads.

feat_req__feo__application_lifecycle

The lifecycle of an `Application` consists of 3 phases: Init, Run and Shutdown.

valid

The Application Lifecycle consists of 3 phases: Init, Run and Shutdown.

feat_req__feo__deadline_supervision

Support of deadline supervision checkpoints

valid

The framework shall provide the functionality to enable the reporting of deadline supervision checkpoints to an external health management system (e.g. watchdog)

feat_req__feo__logical_supervision

Support of logical supervision

valid

The framework shall provide the functionality to enable the reporting of logical supervision checkpoints to an external health management system (e.g. watchdog)

feat_req__feo__response_term_request

Response to termination request

valid

If the primary process receives a termination signal, it shall call the shutdown function of all remaining activities in arbitrary sequence and terminate itself. If a secondary process receives a termination signal, it shall terminate itself.

feat_req__feo__secondary_conn_timeout

Secondary connection timeout

valid

If not all secondary processes connect to the primary in time, the primary shall terminate itself. The startup functions shall not be triggered.

feat_req__feo__service_activity

Definition: Service Activity

valid

* Service activities are a means to interact with the outside world, e.g. via network communication, direct sensor input or direct actuator output * Service activities may also use APIs external to the framework (e.g. networking APIs, reading from external sensor devices, writing HW I/O, etc.)

feat_req__feo__startup_timeout

Startup timeout

valid

If not all activities reach their initialized state within a certain period of time (startup timeout), the primary process shall shutdown all successfully started activities in arbitrary sequence and terminate itself.

feat_req__feo__task_chain

Definition: Task Chain

valid

All activities within an application are arranged within a `Task Chain`. There is exactly one task chain per application. The task chain configuration defines the execution order of the activities. In particular it defines when the task chain is activated (typically in a cyclic manner) and in which order the activities will run. Every task chain may have one or multiple input service activities which will run in the beginning. The purpose of an input service activity is to collect external input signals and provide them to the other activities during task chain execution. Every task may have one or more output service activities which will run in the end. The purpose of an output service activity is to collect signals produced by activities within the task chain and send them to external entities.

feat_req__feo__trustable_computation

Trustable computation

valid

The framework shall provide mechanisms to check after the computation of an Activity if the result is trustable. This can be done e.g. via evaluation of floating point exceptions, checking of hardware registers or status information of the software platform.

feat_req__gen_ai__structured_vapi

Structured Vehicle Interface

valid

The platform shall provide structured APIs (e.g., via MCP) to access vehicle state and invoke safe vehicle commands.

feat_req__gen_ai__ui

GenAI Interaction Layer

valid

The platform shall provide a Prompting Interface for GenAI-based agents, enabling structured prompts, streaming output, and context-aware user interaction.

feat_req__gen_ai__validator

GenAI Action Validation

valid

The platform shall validate all LLM-generated actions via domain-specific policies before they are executed.

feat_req__gen_ai__workloads_execution

GenAI Execution

valid

The platform shall support the execution of Generative AI models (e.g., LLMs) on embedded automotive hardware.

feat_req__ipc__availability

IPC Availability

valid

The IPC binding shall ensure availability of its communication, so that the availability is independent per criticality level.

feat_req__ipc__confidentiality

IPC Confidentiality

valid

The IPC binding shall ensure confidentiality of its communication.

feat_req__ipc__integrity

IPC Integrity

valid

The IPC binding shall ensure integrity of its communication.

feat_req__ipc__zero_copy

Zero-Copy Approach

valid

IPC communication shall be possible without copying to-be-transferred data.

feat_req__lifecycle__component_group_config

Component grouping configuration

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall provide support for grouping sets of :term:`Components <Component>` to share configuration.

feat_req__lifecycle__conditional_startup

Conditional launching

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall provide launching processes based on conditions.

feat_req__lifecycle__config_file_support

Configuration file support

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall support modular configuration files to configure process attributes, including configurations coming from external formats such as OCI runtime configuration.

feat_req__lifecycle__control_commands

Control commands

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall provide support for run-target selection.

feat_req__lifecycle__controlif_status

Report "started/running/degraded"

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall be able to report status on components via the :term:`Control Interface`. Note: status can be "started/running/degraded" - refer to documentation for details

feat_req__lifecycle__custom_cond_support

Control interface support

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall provide support to wait for configurable custom conditions, which can be signaled from applications via :term:`Control Interface`.

feat_req__lifecycle__deps_visualization

Configuration Dependency view

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall have the means to generate the specified dependencies in a format that can be visualized.

feat_req__lifecycle__hm_checkpoint

Health Monitor checkpoint supervision

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall support checkpoint supervision to allow monitoring periodic execution within applications to detect failures.

feat_req__lifecycle__hm_deadline

Health Monitor deadline supervision

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall support deadline supervision to allow monitoring timely execution within applications to detect timing violations.

feat_req__lifecycle__hm_logical

Health Monitor logical supervision

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall support logical supervision to allow monitoring execution flow within applications to detect logical errors.

feat_req__lifecycle__launch_support

Support for launching processes

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall provide support for launching :term:`Processes <Process>`.

feat_req__lifecycle__liveliness_detection

Process liveliness detection

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall be able to detect and react to loss of :term:`Liveliness` of the :term:`Processes <Process>` it owns, by monitoring the state of the :term:`Processes <Process>` as specified by the set of executables.

feat_req__lifecycle__lm_self_health_check

Launch manager self health check

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall implement time based cyclical monitoring of itself.

feat_req__lifecycle__logging_support

Logging support

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall support logging of process launch, monitoring, and configuration activities.

feat_req__lifecycle__monitor_abnormal_term

Process crash monitoring

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall provide support for monitoring abnormal termination of :term:`Processes <Process>`.

feat_req__lifecycle__multi_instance_support

Multi-instance

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall be able to run in multiple instances with its own configurations on a system.

feat_req__lifecycle__oci_compliant

OCI Compliant

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall be compliant to the `OCI Specification v1.2.0 <https://github.com/opencontainers/runtime-spec/releases/tag/v1.2.0>`__.

feat_req__lifecycle__parallel_launch_support

Launching processes in parallel

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall provide support for launching :term:`Processes <Process>` in parallel.

feat_req__lifecycle__process_ordering

Process dependency handling

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall provide support for ordering the launching of :term:`Processes <Process>` based on the dependencies.

feat_req__lifecycle__process_termination

Terminating process

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall provide support for terminating :term:`Processes <Process>`.

feat_req__lifecycle__prog_lang

Lifecycle programing language support

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall support Rust and C++ programming languages.

feat_req__lifecycle__query_commands

Query commands

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall provide support for commands to query component states.

feat_req__lifecycle__recov_run_target_switch

Run target switch as recovery action

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall support switching to a different :term:`Run target` as recovery action in case a single process terminated abnormally or lost its :term:`Liveliness`.

feat_req__lifecycle__recovery_action_support

Recovery action

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall support :term:`Recovery Action` for the abnormally terminated :term:`Processes <Process>`.

feat_req__lifecycle__request_run_target_start

Request run target launch

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall be able to start a named :term:`Run target` respecting the dependencies when requested.

feat_req__lifecycle__run_target_support

Run target support

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall provide support for :term:`run targets <Run target>` to define collections of :term:`Processes <Process>` that can be launched together.

feat_req__lifecycle__running_processes

Process adoption

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall be able to control already running :term:`Processes <Process>`.

feat_req__lifecycle__session_extension

Updating configuration

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall provide support for extending already running session with additional new configuration file.

feat_req__lifecycle__smart_watchdog_config

Monitoring and recovery: watchdog support

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall support a smart :term:`Watchdog`, configurable per process.

feat_req__lifecycle__start_named_run_target

Launching run target

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall be able to start a named :term:`Run target`.

feat_req__lifecycle__switch_run_targets

Switch between run targets

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall be able to switch between different :term:`run targets <Run target>`.

feat_req__lifecycle__terminationn_dependency

Handling process dependency in termination

valid

The :term:`Lifecycle Feature` shall terminate the :term:`Processes <Process>` based on the dependency order.

feat_req__log__err_handling_nonrec

Error Handling - Non-Recoverable Errors

valid

feat_req__logging__asil_support

Safety - ASIL Level Support

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support the ASIL level of the user function to ensure compliance with the safety requirements of the application. Additional Information: Freedom from interfernce must be guaranteed with regard to the calling components.

feat_req__logging__boot_logging

Previous boot logging

valid

feat_req__logging__compat_dlt

Compatibility - DLT Protocol

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall be :term:`DLT` compatible. Additional Information: support for DLT message format, sending and receiving DLT messages, and integration with existing DLT tools and infrastructure.

feat_req__logging__compat_languages

Compatibility - Supported Programming Languages

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support C++, Rust programming languages.

feat_req__logging__compat_os

Compatibility - Supported Operating Systems

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support QNX and Linux operating systems (encapsulated via OSAL).

feat_req__logging__config_buffer_size

Configuration - Buffer Size

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall allow configuration of internal buffers sizes.

feat_req__logging__config_custom_types

Configuration - Custom Types Extension

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall allow extensions for custom log types.

feat_req__logging__config_entity_id

Configuration - Logging Entity ID

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall allow configuration of logging entity IDs.

feat_req__logging__config_fallback

Configuration - Fallback Configurations

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall provide fallback configurations, such as application-wide or system-wide defaults.

feat_req__logging__config_log_filter

Configuration - Log Filter

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall allow configuration of log filters.

feat_req__logging__config_log_level

Configuration - Log Level

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support configuration of :term:`log levels <Log level>`.

feat_req__logging__config_on_demand

Configuration - On-Demand Functionality

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support on-demand functionality, such as enabling or disabling log storage.

feat_req__logging__config_permissions

Configuration - Permission Settings

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall allow configuration of permission settings for log access.

feat_req__logging__config_storage_size

Configuration - Storage Size

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall allow configuration of storage size per log file.

feat_req__logging__context_log_level

Context-Specific Log Level Activation

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall allow context-specific :term:`log level` activation at runtime to enable fine-grained control over logging behavior.

feat_req__logging__early_startup

Logging of Early Startup Events

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support logging of early startup events to capture critical initialization information.

feat_req__logging__entity_identifier

Log entity Identifier

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support :term:`logging entity identifiers<logging entity identifier>` for each log entry.

feat_req__logging__error_handling_isolation

Error Handling - Application Isolation

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall ensure that user applications are not affected by logging :term:`framework` errors.

feat_req__logging__error_handling_recoverable

Error Handling - Recoverable Errors

valid

In case of recoverable error, the logging :term:`framework` shall continue the current operations.

feat_req__logging__filtering_entity_id

Log Filtering - Logging Entity ID

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support filtering by :term:`logging entity identifiers<logging entity identifier>`.

feat_req__logging__filtering_log_levels

Log Filtering - Log Levels

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support filtering by :term:`log levels <Log level>`.

feat_req__logging__log_sinks_cloud_drive

Log Sinks - Cloud Native Drive

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support cloud-native drives via network as log sinks.

feat_req__logging__log_sinks_console

Log Sinks - Console

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support console as a log sink.

feat_req__logging__log_sinks_local_fs

Log Sinks - Local File System

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support local file system as log sink.

feat_req__logging__log_sinks_network

Log Sinks - Network

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support network channels, including a second dedicated Ethernet channel, as log sinks.

feat_req__logging__log_sinks_stdout

Log Sinks - Stdout for Unit Tests

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall ensure logs appear on stdout when running unit tests.

feat_req__logging__log_sources

Log Sources - Component and Platform

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support :term:`component` features and :term:` platform` as log sources.

feat_req__logging__log_sources_user_app

Log Sources - User Application

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support user application as log source.

feat_req__logging__message_loss_detection

Message Loss Detection - Detection and Reporting

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall detect and report any message loss.

feat_req__logging__message_loss_handling

Message Loss Detection - Graceful Handling

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall provide mechanisms to handle message loss gracefully. Additional Information: e.g. buffering or prioritizing critical messages

feat_req__logging__prioritization

Log Prioritization

valid

The logging framework shall prioritize logs in case of resource conflicts to ensure critical logs are not lost.

feat_req__logging__qos_message_handling

Quality of Service - Message Handling

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall provide:term:` QoS` for handling overflows or dropping log messages.

feat_req__logging__resource_comm_channel

Resource Consumption - Communication Channel

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall minimize communication channel resource consumption.

feat_req__logging__resource_performance

Resource Consumption - Performance Impact

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall have low impact on overall system performance.

feat_req__logging__resource_runtime

Resource Consumption - Runtime Resources

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall minimize runtime resource consumption.

feat_req__logging__resource_storage

Resource Consumption - Storage

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall minimize storage resource consumption.

feat_req__logging__security_log_access

Security - Log File Access

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall ensure that only authorized users can access log files.

feat_req__logging__severity_levels

Log Severity Levels

valid

The logging framework shall support a log level for each log entry.

feat_req__logging__sink_device

Log Sinks - Storage Device

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support configuration of the log storage device.

feat_req__logging__sink_multiple_device

Log Sinks - multiple Storage Device

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support multiple log storage devices.

feat_req__logging__sink_strategy

Log Sinks - Storage Strategy

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support configurable :term:`log storage strategy`.

feat_req__logging__system_class

Safety - System Classification

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall be classified according to the overall system's safety concept if logging information is part of the verification strategy.

feat_req__logging__timestamping_local

Timestamping - Local Timestamp

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support local timestamps for each log entry.

feat_req__logging__timestamping_original

Timestamping - Original Timestamp

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support original timestamps for routed log entries.

feat_req__logging__timestamping_sync

Timestamping - Timestamp Synchronization

valid

The logging :term:`framework` shall support timestamp synchronization for log entries coming from different :term:`logging nodes <logging node>`.

feat_req__orchestration__exec_async_rt

Async Cooperative Task Runtime

valid

The executor shall provide a cooperative task runtime for async programming based on the definition of Rust's async model (see `Asynchronous Programming in Rust <https://rust-lang.github.io/async-book>`).

feat_req__orchestration__exec_block_threads

Dedicated Threads for Blocking Operations

valid

The system shall support execution of tasks containing blocking calls on dedicated OS threads isolated from cooperative scheduling.

feat_req__orchestration__exec_fifo_fair_sched

FIFO or Fairness Scheduling

valid

The Executor shall support FIFO or fairness-based scheduling among cooperative tasks.

feat_req__orchestration__exec_fixed_pool

Fixed-Size Thread Pool

valid

Executor instances shall run tasks on a statically configured thread pool with a fixed thread count.

feat_req__orchestration__exec_no_int_prios

No Internal Priorities for Cooperative Tasks

valid

Cooperative tasks within an Executor shall execute without internal priority distinctions.

feat_req__orchestration__exec_os_prio

Uniform OS Priority for Non-Safety Threads

valid

Threads within an Executor not involved in safety-critical tasks shall share identical OS-level priority.

feat_req__orchestration__exec_pool_isolation

Isolated Thread Pools

valid

Executor instances shall isolate their thread pools from each other.

feat_req__orchestration__exec_preempt_safety

Preemptive Scheduling for Safety Tasks

invalid

The Executor shall support preemptive scheduling of special safety-critical tasks, guaranteeing their execution.

feat_req__orchestration__exec_safe_task_prio

Separate Priority for Safety Tasks

invalid

Safety-critical tasks shall be prioritized separately from standard cooperative tasks.

feat_req__orchestration__exec_scale_instances

Scale via Additional Executors

valid

Scaling of Executor resources shall be achieved through additional Executor instances rather than dynamic thread scaling.

feat_req__orchestration__exec_thread_aff

Configurable Thread Affinity

valid

Thread affinity to CPU cores shall be configurable per Executor instance.

feat_req__orchestration__exec_yielding

Yielding Guidelines for Long Operations

valid

The executor shall provide guidelines for dividing long-running operations into smaller, cooperatively yielding segments.

feat_req__orchestration__ext_health_inds

Health Indicators Export

valid

Executor and Orchestrator frameworks shall expose health indicators for integration with external supervisory systems.

feat_req__orchestration__ext_task_health

Internal Task Health Verification

valid

Frameworks shall internally verify task-level health status based on timing constraints and fault-handling execution.

feat_req__orchestration__gen_det_scale

Determinism and Scalability

valid

The Executor and Orchestrator shall maintain determinism and scalability suitable for mixed-criticality environments.

feat_req__orchestration__gen_excl_ipc

Exclusive Use of IPC Feature for Inter Process Synchronization

invalid

The system shall use the approved IPC feature exclusively for all inter-process synchronization.

feat_req__orchestration__gen_preempt_act

Explicit Preemption Activation

invalid

Preemptive scheduling shall only be activated explicitly for tasks with safety or critical timing constraints.

feat_req__orchestration__obsv_flow_vis

Program Flow and Timing Visibility

valid

Observability shall provide visibility into Program execution flow, event synchronization points, and timing violations.

feat_req__orchestration__obsv_fw_integ

Integration with Tracing Frameworks

valid

Tracing points shall integrate seamlessly with established tracing frameworks like Perfetto and LTTng.

feat_req__orchestration__obsv_lifecycle_qm

Task Lifecycle and Queue Metrics

valid

Observability shall capture task lifecycle events, Executor queue metrics, and mapping of user-space tasks to OS threads.

feat_req__orchestration__obsv_trace_corr

Trace Correlation Points

valid

The Executor and Orchestrator shall expose structured tracing points correlating user-space task scheduling with OS-level scheduling.

feat_req__orchestration__orch_code_api

Code-First Integration API

valid

The Orchestrator shall offer a code-first API to integrate directly with application logic without external DSL/IDL.

feat_req__orchestration__orch_ctrl_flows

Explicit Control Flows and Timing

valid

Programs shall explicitly define sequential, parallel, conditional execution flows, loops, and timing contracts.

feat_req__orchestration__orch_event_comm

Event-Only Communication

valid

Programs shall communicate exclusively through explicitly defined events.

feat_req__orchestration__orch_event_sync

Event-Based Synchronization

valid

Programs shall support explicit event-based synchronization and trigger conditions.

feat_req__orchestration__orch_fault_mon

Fault-Handling and Monitors

valid

Programs shall contain integrated fault-handling logic and execution monitors to enforce timing constraints.

feat_req__orchestration__orch_multi_prog

Multi-Program Support per Executor

valid

Executors may host multiple Programs to support resource sharing.

feat_req__orchestration__orch_safety_tasks

Safety Tasks in Programs

invalid

Critical timing or safety paths within Programs shall be executed via preemptive special tasks provided by the Executor.

feat_req__orchestration__orch_single_deploy

Single-Executor Deployment

valid

Each Program shall be deployed exclusively on a single Executor instance.

feat_req__orchestration__orch_static_graphs

Static Program Execution Graphs

valid

The Orchestrator shall provide a runtime-static Program abstraction representing computation logic as execution graphs.

feat_req__persistency__access_control

Separate data stores

valid

The Persistency shall ensure that only authorized applications can access individual data stores. .. note:: Access control is essential to prevent unauthorized access and modification of sensitive data. The Persistency shall implement mechanisms to enforce access control policies based on user roles and permissions.

feat_req__persistency__async_api

Asynchronous operation

valid

The Persistency shall provide an asynchronous API for time consuming operations like loading and storing of data.

feat_req__persistency__async_completion

Signalling completion of asynchronous operation

valid

The Persistency shall provide a mechanism to signal the completion of an asynchronous operations to the application.

feat_req__persistency__atomic_store

Atomic store operation

valid

The Persistency shall support atomic write operation for entire storage to ensure data consistency. .. note:: Atomic write operation guarantee that either all key-value pairs are written, or no changes are made at all. This is required to prevent malfunctions when individual key-value pairs are dependent on each other.

feat_req__persistency__cached_access

Cached access

valid

The Persistency shall support caching mechanisms to improve access times for frequently accessed key-value pairs.

feat_req__persistency__cfg

Configuration

valid

The Persistency shall support configuration via a configuration file. The configuration shall include: - Global settings: - Maximum number of KVS instances - Maximum size of a key - Settings for KVS instance: - Instance identifier - Storage URI - Maximum number of Key-Value pairs - Maximum number of snapshots - Maximum consumed storage size (Including all metadata and redundant data) - Security settings - Redundancy settings - Backend specific settings Configuration file shall be optional and all configuration attributes shall have sensible default values defined at compile time. .. note:: To improve the user experience during rapid prototyping, the Persistency shall also be able to operate without a configuration file.

feat_req__persistency__concurrency

Intra-Process data access

valid

The Persistency shall support concurrent access to key-value pairs from multiple threads within the same process.

feat_req__persistency__confidential_storage

Confidential storage

valid

The Persistency shall support confidential storage of key-value pairs using encryption mechanisms. .. note:: Confidential storage is essential to protect sensitive data from unauthorized access, especially in scenarios where the storage medium may be exposed to potential threats.

feat_req__persistency__cpp_rust

C++ and Rust language support

valid

The Persistency shall provide native API support for both C++ and Rust programming languages.

feat_req__persistency__default_value_file

Provisioning of default values via external file

valid

The Persistency shall support import of default values using an external file. .. note:: Default values are read-only and cannot be modified at runtime. This requirement addresses the provisioning of default values during initial deployment. See :need:`feat_req__persistency__tooling`.

feat_req__persistency__default_value_get

Retrieval of default values

valid

The Persistency shall support retrieval of the default value associated with a key.

feat_req__persistency__default_values

Default values

valid

The Persistency shall support predefined default values for keys.

feat_req__persistency__dev_mode

Support development mode

valid

The Persistency shall support the development mode. The development mode shall allow unrestricted data access and bypass security policies.

feat_req__persistency__direct_access

Direct access

valid

The Persistency shall support direct access to key-value pairs without the necessity to load the entire storage to RAM in advance. .. note:: Direct access improves availability of data and reduces memory consumption for large data sets.

feat_req__persistency__dynamic_memory_alloc

Dynamic memory allocation during runtime

valid

The Persistency shall not allocate dynamic memory during runtime. All required dynamic memory shall be allocated during initialization. .. note:: Dynamic memory allocation violates freedom from interference as the `HEAP` is a shared resource on OS process level. Additionally, fragmentation of the `HEAP` can lead to non-deterministic behavior of the application.

feat_req__persistency__fast_access

Random access time

valid

The Persistency shall ensure that random read access for key-value pair is completed with constant or logarithmic time complexity relative to the number of stored key-value pairs.

feat_req__persistency__integrity_check

Integrity check

valid

The Persistency shall detect and report data integrity issues.

feat_req__persistency__load_data

Load persistent data

valid

The Persistency shall support loading of key-value pairs from persistent storage.

feat_req__persistency__multiple_app

Access from multiple applications

valid

The Persistency shall prevent access to a single KVS instance from multiple OS processes. .. note:: Access from multiple OS processes violates freedom from interference, as applications can modify the same data concurrently.

feat_req__persistency__multiple_kvs

Multiple KVS per application

valid

The Persistency shall support multiple independent storages per application.

feat_req__persistency__os_agnostic

Operating system agnostic implementation

valid

The Persistency shall be operating system agnostic.

feat_req__persistency__prod_mode

Support production mode

valid

The Persistency shall support the production mode. The production mode should enforce the most restrictive data access controls feasible.

feat_req__persistency__recovery_from_reset

Recovery from reset

valid

The Persistency shall recover to a consistent state after reset. .. note:: After a reset, the Persistency shall ensure that all key-value pairs are in a consistent state, reflecting either the last successful write operation or the previous consistent state.

feat_req__persistency__reset_resistant

Reset resistant storage

valid

The Persistency shall ensure that write operations are reset resistant to prevent data corruption in case of expected or unexpected interruption. .. note:: As the constant power supply can not be guaranteed in embedded systems, it is essential to ensure that write operations are completed successfully, or rolled back to the previous state in case of any kind of interruption.

feat_req__persistency__reset_to_default

Reset to default values

valid

The Persistency shall support reset of individual key or all keys to their default values. This is only applicable for existing keys that have a predefined default value.

feat_req__persistency__snapshot_create

Snapshot create

valid

The Persistency shall support explicit creation of snapshots. Snapshots are identified by unique IDs. Snapshots shall also include the version of the data layout. See :need:`feat_req__persistency__versioning`. .. note:: Snapshots are point-in-time, read-only view on all key-value pairs at moment of snapshot creation. They are typically used for backup and rollback purposes. Implicit snapshots (e.g. created during store operation) shall be prevented to reduce storage consumption.

feat_req__persistency__snapshot_remove

Snapshot remove

valid

The Persistency shall support explicit removal of snapshots.

feat_req__persistency__snapshot_restore

Snapshot restore

valid

The Persistency shall support explicit restoration of snapshots.

feat_req__persistency__storage_backends

Multiple storage backends

valid

The Persistency shall support multiple storage backends. More than one storage backend of the same type shall be optionally supported for the sake of redundancy. The storage backends shall be compile time configurable for each KVS instance. .. note:: Storage backend represents an abstraction for the underlying storage format and mechanism. Configurable storage backends allow the user to select the most suitable solution for their specific use case (Performance, easy of use, resource consumption, ...).

feat_req__persistency__store_data

Store persistent data

valid

The Persistency shall support storing of key-value pairs to persistent storage.

feat_req__persistency__support_datatype_keys

Supported datatypes (Keys)

valid

The Persistency shall support UTF-8 encoded strings as valid key types.

feat_req__persistency__support_datatype_value

Supported datatypes (Values)

valid

The Persistency shall support storing both primitive and non-primitive (composite) datatypes as values.

feat_req__persistency__tooling

Tooling

valid

The Persistency shall provide tooling support for: - viewing and modifying key-value pairs during development, testing and debugging - provisioning of default values via external file

feat_req__persistency__update_mechanism

Update Mechanism

valid

The Persistency shall implement mechanisms to upgrade from one version to another, including multi-version jumps.

feat_req__persistency__variant_management

Variant management support

valid

The Persistency shall ensure compatibility across different SW versions.

feat_req__persistency__versioning

Versioning

valid

The Persistency shall support versioning for different data representation of KVS. .. note:: Versioning is essential to ensure compatibility between different versions of the Persistency and the stored data. Each version shall be uniquely identifiable and include information of the data layout and structure.

feat_req__persistency__write_amplification

Write amplification minimization

valid

The Persistency shall minimize the write amplification during data storage operations to enhance performance and prolong the lifespan of the underlying storage medium. .. note:: Write amplification refers to the phenomenon where the amount of data written to the storage medium exceeds the amount of user data intended to be written. Minimizing write amplification is crucial for optimizing performance and reducing wear on storage devices, especially in embedded systems with limited number of program-erase cycles.

feat_req__sec_crypt__access_control

Access Control

valid

The security component shall support roles and capability rights management to enforce access control to cryptographic functions and key material.

feat_req__sec_crypt__algo_naming

Standardized Algorithm Naming

valid

The security component shall use a uniform and unambiguous naming scheme for cryptographic algorithms.

feat_req__sec_crypt__algo_updates

Crypto Algorithm Update Strategy

valid

The security component shall allow the updating of its cryptographic algorithms.

feat_req__sec_crypt__api_lifecycle

API Lifecycle Management

valid

The security component API shall provide clear mechanisms for initialization, context management (request, reuse, release), and de-initialization of cryptographic resources.

feat_req__sec_crypt__asym_algo_ecdh

ECDH Support

valid

The security component shall support the ECDH algorithm for key exchange.

feat_req__sec_crypt__asym_encryption

Asymmetric Encryption and Decryption

valid

The security component shall provide functionality for asymmetric encryption and decryption.

feat_req__sec_crypt__cert_management

Certificate Management

valid

The security component shall provide functionality to manage a set of signed and verified (trusted) certificates.

feat_req__sec_crypt__dos_mitigation

Denial-of-Service (DoS) Mitigation

valid

The security component shall incorporate measures to mitigate the risk of Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks that could be caused by malicious messages creating exceptional computational load.

feat_req__sec_crypt__error_handling

Structured Error Handling

valid

The security component shall provide a structured and consistent mechanism for error reporting and logging.

feat_req__sec_crypt__flexible_api

API to allow selection of different algorithms

valid

The API of the security component shall allow a selection of the available algorithms based on their unique name.

feat_req__sec_crypt__hashing

Hashing Functionality

valid

The security component shall provide hashing functionality.

feat_req__sec_crypt__hashing_algo_sha2

SHA-2 Support

valid

The security component shall support the SHA-2 hashing algorithm.

feat_req__sec_crypt__hashing_algo_sha3

SHA-3 Support

valid

The security component shall support the SHA-3 hashing algorithm.

feat_req__sec_crypt__hw_acceleration

Hardware Acceleration Support

valid

The security component shall be able to rely on hardware acceleration for cryptographic operations.

feat_req__sec_crypt__ids_integration

Intrusion Detection System (IDS) Integration

valid

The security component shall provide a mechanism to report potential security anomalies or threats to an Intrusion Detection System (IDS).

feat_req__sec_crypt__kdf

Key Derivation

valid

The security component shall provide Key Derivation Functions (KDFs) to derive one or more secret keys from a master key or password.

feat_req__sec_crypt__key_deletion

Secure Key Deletion

valid

The security component shall support the secure deletion of key material.

feat_req__sec_crypt__key_generation

Secure Key Generation

valid

The security component shall support the secure generation of key material.

feat_req__sec_crypt__key_import

Secure Key Import

valid

The security component shall support the secure import of key material.

feat_req__sec_crypt__key_storage

Secure Key Storage

valid

The security component shall support the secure storage of key material.

feat_req__sec_crypt__mac

Message Authentication Code

valid

The security component shall provide functionality for Message Authentication Codes (MAC) to ensure message integrity and authenticity.

feat_req__sec_crypt__no_key_exposure

No Key Material Exposure

valid

The API of the security component shall not reveal key material to its users.

feat_req__sec_crypt__os_protection

OS-Level Protection

valid

The security component shall use system-level means (e.g., co-processor, HSM, TEE) to protect its memory and CPU from applications and the normal operating system.

feat_req__sec_crypt__performance_tooling

Performance benchmark tooling

valid

The security component shall contain a set of extendable benchmark tests to derive KPIs from running all it's cryptographic operations on different systems.

feat_req__sec_crypt__pqc_readiness

Post-Quantum Readiness

valid

The security component shall be designed to be ready for post-quantum cryptography.

feat_req__sec_crypt__production_keys

Initial Production Key Handling

valid

The security component shall consider the production scenario where initial production keys are brought into the system.

feat_req__sec_crypt__reverse_eng_protection

Reverse Engineering Protection

valid

The security component shall withstand reverse engineering of its secrets.

feat_req__sec_crypt__rng

Entropy Source

valid

The security component shall provide a source of entropy for random number generation.

feat_req__sec_crypt__rng_algo_chacha20rng

ChaCha20Rng Support

valid

The security component shall use the ChaCha20Rng algorithm for random number generation.

feat_req__sec_crypt__security_concept

Security Concept

valid

A security concept shall be created for the security component, including security goals, plausible attacks, critical failures, and countermeasures.

feat_req__sec_crypt__side_channel_mitigation

Side-Channel Attack Mitigation

valid

The security component shall be designed to mitigate side-channel and timing attacks.

feat_req__sec_crypt__sig_algo_ecdsa

ECDSA Support

valid

The security component shall support the ECDSA algorithm for digital signatures.

feat_req__sec_crypt__sig_creation

Signature Creation

valid

The security component shall provide functionality to create digital signatures.

feat_req__sec_crypt__sig_verification

Signature Verification

valid

The security component shall provide functionality to verify digital signatures.

feat_req__sec_crypt__sw_fallback

Software Fallback

valid

A software-only solution for cryptographic operations shall be available as a fallback.

feat_req__sec_crypt__sym_algo_chacha20

ChaCha20-Poly1305 Support

valid

The security component shall support the ChaCha20-Poly1305 symmetric encryption algorithm.

feat_req__sec_crypt__sym_sym_algo_aes_ccm

AES-CCM Support

valid

The security component shall support the AES-CCM symmetric encryption algorithm.

feat_req__sec_crypt__sym_sym_algo_aes_gcm

AES-GCM Support

valid

The security component shall support the AES-GCM symmetric encryption algorithm.

feat_req__sec_crypt__sym_symm_algo_aes_cbc

AES-CBC Support

valid

The security component shall support the AES-CBC symmetric encryption algorithm.

feat_req__sec_crypt__sym_symmetric_encrypt

Symmetric Encryption and Decryption

valid

The security component shall provide functionality for symmetric encryption and decryption.

feat_req__sec_crypt__tls_support

TLS Support

valid

The security component shall support the Transport Layer Security (TLS) 1.3 protocol for secure communication over Ethernet.

feat_req__sec_crypt__trusted_time

Trusted Time Source

valid

The security component shall have access to a trusted real-world wall clock.

feat_req__some_ip_gateway__e2e_plugin_ifc

Plug-In-IFC for End-to-End protection modules

valid

The SOME/IP Gateway shall support an interface to plug-in a E2E protection service implementation.

feat_req__some_ip_gateway__e2e_specs

Compatibility with some-ip.com E2E Protocol Specification

valid

The E2E protection implementation shall be fully compatible and complying with the E2E protocol specification from `some-ip.com <https://some-ip.com/>`_.

feat_req__some_ip_gateway__someip_protocol

Compatibility with Open SOME/IP Protocol Specification

valid

The SOME/IP protocol implementation shall be fully compatible and complying with the SOME/IP protocol specification from `Open SOME/IP <https://github.com/some-ip-com/open-someip-spec>`_.

feat_req__some_ip_gateway__someip_sd_protocol

Compatibility with Open SOME/IP Service Discovery Protocol Specification

valid

The Service Discovery implementation shall be fully compatible and complying with the SOME/IP service discovery specification from `Open SOME/IP <https://github.com/some-ip-com/open-someip-spec>`_.

feat_req__some_ip_gateway__stack_plugin_ifc

Plug-In-IFC for SOME/IP protocol stacks

valid

The SOME/IP Gateway shall support an interface to plug-in a SOME/IP stack implementation.

feat_req__time__abs_acc_qual

Absolute Time base accuracy qualifier

valid

The **score::time feature** shall provide an API to read accuracy qualifier of the absolute time base, synchronized to external time sources. Note: the inaccuracy could be indicated in the following manner * Inaccuracy higher than 24h * Inaccuracy less than 24h * Inaccuracy less than 1h * Inaccuracy less than 15min * Inaccuracy less than 60s * Inaccuracy less than 10s * Inaccuracy less than 1s * Inaccuracy less than 500ms * Inaccuracy less than 100ms * Inaccuracy less than 50ms * Inaccuracy less than 10ms * Inaccuracy not available

feat_req__time__abs_base_api

Absolute Time base API

valid

The **score::time feature** shall provide an API to read the absolute time base, synchronized to external time sources.

feat_req__time__abs_sec_qual

Absolute Time base security qualifier

valid

The **score::time feature** shall provide an API to read security qualifier of the absolute time base, synchronized to external time sources. Note: the security level might be indicated in the following steps * No time available * Time not trustworthy * Time trustworthy * Time very trustworthy

feat_req__time__abs_sync

score::time external synchronization

valid

The **score::time feature** shall support synchronization with external time sources, such as UTC time from GPS.

feat_req__time__abs_sync_log

Absolute Time synchronization status log

valid

The **score::time feature** shall provide a mechanism to log the internal state of the absolute time synchronization process, to be able to debug and diagnose the synchronization process.

feat_req__time__high_prec_clock_api

High precision clock API

valid

The **score::time feature** shall provide an API to read the high precision clock in nanoseconds precision. Note: to which clock the high precision clock is mapped, depends on the system design. *Use case:* such clocks might be used for time-critical applications, such as audio/video streaming, event logging, and diagnostics.

feat_req__time__mocking_apis

score::time mocking APIs implementation

valid

The **score::time feature** shall provide support for mocking its public interfaces, enabling unit, component and integration testing of applications.

feat_req__time__monotonic_clock_api

Monotonic clock API

valid

The **score::time feature** shall provide an API to read monotonic, not adjustable clock value.

feat_req__time__vehicle_time_acc_qual_api

Vehicle Time base accuracy qualifier

valid

The **score::time feature** shall provide an API to read the accuracy qualifier of the local synchronized time base. Note: qualifier shall reflect the accuracy of the local time base, e.g. * if it is synchronized to an external time source or not, * are there any instabilities, like time jumps to the past or to the future * does the time increase in a monotonic manner.

feat_req__time__vehicle_time_ctrl_flow

Vehicle Time control flow

valid

The **score::time feature** shall provide an access its data via specified APIs in a fast and very efficient manner, avoiding, if possible, kernel calls, resource manager involvement and so on. For APIs see: * feat_req__time__vehicle_time__time_api * feat_req__time__vehicle_time__acc_qual_api * feat_req__time__vehicle_time__time_pt_qual *Use case:* frequent access to the current synchronized time and its metadata by multiple clients within one ECU.

feat_req__time__vehicle_time_sync

Vehicle Time synchronization

valid

The **score::time feature** shall synchronize the local clock with an external **Time Master** using the gPTP protocol (IEEE 802.1AS).

feat_req__time__vehicle_time_sync_log

Vehicle Time synchronization logging

valid

The **score::time feature** shall provide a mechanism to log the internal state of the synchronization process, to be able to debug and diagnose the synchronization process. *Use case:* Debugging and diagnostics of the time synchronization process.

feat_req__time__vehicle_time_sync_prec

Vehicle Time synchronization precision

valid

The **score::time feature** shall synchronize the local time, see feat_req__time__vehicle_time__sync, base with **Time Master** within a defined precision, based on the system setup. Note: * the particular target precision depends on the system setup * for AVB nodes the maximum difference in the synchronized time between two AVB ports/ECUs while both are in state SYNC, and could be 1 usec * for non-AVB node the precision is relaxed, and could be 200-500 usec

feat_req__time__vehicle_time_time_api

Vehicle Time base API

valid

The **score::time feature** shall provide an API to access the synchronized vehicle time.

feat_req__time__vehicle_time_time_pt_qual

Vehicle Time base time point qualifier

valid

The **score::time feature** shall provide an API to read the time point qualifier of the local synchronized time base. Note: qualifier shall reflect if the time point could be treated as ASIL-B data or QM data

It extends as a decent documentation for users and contributors beyond the pure release notes created according to the template :need:`gd_temp__rel_plat_rel_note`.
